note: Quantities are for `serves` people. `qty` is in `unit` (g, ml or each); `amount` is the same quantity as the app shows it. `cupboard` items are assumed in stock.

recipes.title: Chipotle chicken tacos with pineapple salsa
recipes.blurb: Smoky, sticky chicken in warm tortillas with a sharp pineapple and red onion salsa.
steps: Mix the chipotle paste, smoked paprika, cumin, garlic, half the lime juice, half the oil and a pinch of salt in a bowl. Stir the chicken through and leave it while you make the salsa.
For the salsa, combine the pineapple, half the red onion, the chilli and most of the coriander with a squeeze of lime, a pinch of salt and pepper.
Stir the yoghurt with the rest of the lime juice and a pinch of salt to make a cooling drizzle.
Heat the remaining oil in a large frying pan over a high heat. Fry the chicken for 7 to 8 minutes, turning, until cooked through with sticky charred edges.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or microwave for 30 seconds. Fill with chicken, a spoonful of salsa, the lime yoghurt, the remaining red onion and a scatter of coriander.

recipes.title: Beef and bean burritos with lime rice
recipes.blurb: Spiced beef and kidney beans rolled up with cheddar and zesty rice, then crisped in the pan.
steps: Rinse the rice, then cook it in plenty of boiling salted water for 10 to 12 minutes. Drain and steam dry for a few minutes.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large frying pan and cook the onion and pepper for 6 minutes until softened. Add the garlic, chilli powder, cumin and paprika and stir for 1 minute.
Add the mince and brown it hard for 5 minutes, breaking it up. Pour in the tomatoes, beans and jalapenos and simmer for 10 minutes until thick. Season well.
Stir the zest and juice of the lime and the coriander through the rice with a pinch of salt.
Lay the tortillas flat. Spoon rice, beef and bean mix, cheddar and a little yoghurt down the middle of each, fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Wipe out the pan and toast the burritos seam-side down over a medium heat for 2 minutes each side until golden. Serve with the remaining yoghurt.

recipes.title: Black bean and sweet potato enchiladas
recipes.blurb: Roasted sweet potato and black beans rolled in tortillas, baked under tomato sauce and melted cheddar.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Roast the sweet potato on a tray with half the oil, half the cumin, half the paprika and a pinch of salt for 20 minutes until tender and caramelised at the edges.
Meanwhile, soften the onion in the remaining oil in a saucepan for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, chilli powder and remaining cumin and paprika, then the passata. Simmer for 8 minutes and season.
Tip the roasted sweet potato into a bowl with the black beans and spinach, and crush a little with a fork so it holds together.
Spread a few spoonfuls of sauce in a baking dish. Fill each tortilla with the sweet potato mix, roll up and nestle seam-side down in the dish.
Pour over the rest of the sauce, scatter with cheddar and bake for 12 to 15 minutes until bubbling and golden.
Stir the lime juice into the yoghurt. Serve the enchiladas with the lime yoghurt and coriander.

recipes.title: Halloumi and pepper quesadillas
recipes.blurb: Crisp tortillas packed with squeaky halloumi, charred peppers and cheddar, with a quick avocado salsa.
steps: Heat half the oil in a large frying pan over a high heat. Fry the peppers and half the onion for 5 minutes until blistered, adding the cumin and paprika for the last minute. Tip into a bowl.
In the same pan, fry the halloumi for 3 to 4 minutes, turning, until golden on most sides. Add it to the peppers with the jalapenos and cheddar and toss.
For the salsa, mix the avocado, tomatoes, remaining onion, coriander, half the lime juice, salt and pepper.
Spread the filling over half of each tortilla and fold over. Wipe the pan, add a drop of the remaining oil and toast each quesadilla for 2 minutes per side until crisp and the cheese has melted.
Cut into wedges and serve with the salsa and the yoghurt loosened with the remaining lime juice.

recipes.title: Smoky black bean tacos with lime avocado
recipes.blurb: Spiced black beans piled into warm tortillas with crushed lime avocado and crunchy red cabbage.

ingredients.name: Black beans (400g tin)
ingredients.prep: drained, liquid from the tin kept

steps: Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat. Add the garlic, cumin, paprika and chilli flakes and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the black beans with 3 tablespoons of liquid from the tin. Cook for 5 minutes, crushing about a third of the beans with the back of a spoon, until thick and glossy. Season.
Toss the red cabbage with the juice of ½ lime and a pinch of salt. Mix the onion and tomatoes with half the coriander and the juice of ½ lime.
Mash the avocado with the juice of the remaining lime, the rest of the coriander, salt and pepper.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan. Fill with the beans, avocado, tomato salsa and red cabbage.

recipes.title: Hot chipotle prawn tacos with lime slaw
recipes.blurb: Fiery chipotle prawns in soft tortillas with a cooling crunchy cabbage and carrot slaw.
steps: Toss the prawns with the chipotle paste, paprika, chilli flakes, garlic, half the oil and the juice of ½ lime. Leave for 10 minutes.
Mix the cabbage, carrot, spring onions, most of the coriander and the red chilli with the juice of 1 lime, the yoghurt, salt and pepper.
Heat the remaining oil in a large frying pan over a high heat. Fry the prawns for 2 to 3 minutes each side until pink and lightly charred.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or the microwave.
Fill the tortillas with slaw and prawns, then finish with the last of the coriander and the remaining lime cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Orange and lime pork tacos with pickled onion
recipes.blurb: Quick-marinated pork steaks sliced into tacos with sweet-sharp pink pickled onions.
steps: Squeeze the juice of the orange and the lime into a bowl. Whisk in the garlic, cumin, oregano, chilli powder, chipotle paste, half the oil and a good pinch of salt, then turn the pork steaks in it for 10 minutes.
Put the sliced onion in a small bowl with the vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt. Scrunch with your fingers and leave to turn pink.

Heat a large frying pan over a high heat. Lift the pork from the marinade, pat dry and fry for 4 to 5 minutes each side until cooked through and well browned. Pour the marinade into the pan for the last minute to glaze.
Rest the pork for 3 minutes, then slice thinly.
Warm the tortillas and fill with pork, pickled onion, avocado and coriander.

recipes.title: Chipotle cauliflower tacos with sweetcorn salsa
recipes.blurb: Roasted smoky cauliflower in warm tortillas with sweetcorn salsa and lime avocado.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Whisk the chipotle paste, cumin, garlic, oil and a pinch of salt in a large bowl and toss the cauliflower through until coated.
Spread on a large tray and roast for 25 minutes, turning once, until tender with dark crisp edges.
Mix the sweetcorn, onion, juice of 1 lime and the coriander for the salsa. Season with salt and pepper.
Mash the avocado with the juice of the remaining lime and a pinch of salt.
Warm the tortillas in the oven for the last 2 minutes. Fill with avocado, cauliflower and sweetcorn salsa.

recipes.title: Turkey picadillo with fluffy rice
recipes.blurb: Gently spiced turkey mince with peppers, olives and raisins, a sweet-savoury Latin classic over rice.
steps: Cook the rice in plenty of boiling salted water for 10 to 12 minutes, then drain.
Heat the oil in a large pan and soften the onion and pepper for 6 minutes. Add the garlic, cumin, paprika, oregano and tomato puree and stir for 1 minute.
Add the turkey and cook over a high heat for 6 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink remains.
Pour in the tomatoes and 100 ml of water with the crumbled stock cube. Add the raisins and olives, then simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Stir in the peas for the last 2 minutes, season well and finish with the coriander. Serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Cuban-style black beans and rice
recipes.blurb: Garlicky black beans simmered with peppers and bay, served with rice and creamy avocado.

ingredients.name: Black beans (400g tin)
ingredients.prep: drained, liquid from one tin kept

steps: Cook the rice in plenty of boiling salted water for 10 to 12 minutes, then drain and keep warm.
Heat the oil in a saucepan and cook the onion and green pepper for 8 minutes until soft. Add the garlic, cumin and oregano and stir for 1 minute.
Add the beans, half the reserved bean liquid, 150 ml of water, the bay leaf and the crumbled stock cube. Simmer for 15 minutes, mashing a few beans against the side of the pan to thicken.
Stir in the vinegar, season well and remove the bay leaf.
Serve the beans over the rice with avocado, spring onions, coriander and wedges of lime.

recipes.title: Chimichurri steak with crispy baby potatoes
recipes.blurb: Seared rump steak with a punchy parsley, garlic and chilli sauce and roasted baby potatoes.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the potatoes with 15 ml of the oil and a pinch of salt on a tray and roast for 30 minutes, turning once, until crisp and golden.
For the chimichurri, stir the parsley, coriander, garlic, chilli, vinegar, oregano and 25 ml of oil with a pinch of salt and pepper. Leave to sit.
Take the steak out of the fridge 15 minutes before cooking and season it all over.
Heat a heavy frying pan until very hot. Sear the steak for 3 to 4 minutes each side for medium, then rest it for 5 minutes.
Toss the tomatoes and rocket with a spoonful of chimichurri. Slice the steak against the grain and serve with the potatoes, salad and the rest of the sauce.

recipes.title: Garlic mojo white fish with lime rice
recipes.blurb: Flaky white fish bathed in warm garlic, orange and lime, with fluffy rice and a tomato avocado salad.
steps: Cook the rice in boiling salted water for 10 to 12 minutes. Drain, then stir through the zest of 1 lime and a squeeze of its juice.

Season the fish with cumin, oregano, salt and pepper. Heat 15 ml of the oil in a large non-stick frying pan and fry the fish for 3 to 4 minutes each side until just cooked and flaking. Move to warm plates.
Add the remaining oil to the pan with the garlic and cook gently for 1 minute until pale gold. Pour in the juice of the orange and 1 lime and bubble for 1 minute.
Toss the avocado, tomatoes, half the onion and the coriander with a pinch of salt.
Spoon the warm mojo over the fish and serve with the lime rice, salad and the remaining onion.

recipes.title: Double beef burgers with paprika wedges
recipes.blurb: Thin, crisp-edged beef patties with melted cheddar, burger sauce and smoky potato wedges.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the wedges with 20 ml of the oil, the paprika and a good pinch of salt and roast for 30 to 35 minutes, turning once, until crisp.
Mix the mayonnaise, ketchup and mustard into a sauce. Season the mince lightly and shape it into 4 thin balls.

Heat a large frying pan until very hot with the remaining oil. Squash each ball flat with a spatula, season, and cook for 2 minutes until crusted. Flip, top half the patties with cheddar and cook for 1 minute more.
Toast the buns cut-side down in the pan for 30 seconds.
Build the burgers with sauce, lettuce, tomato, onion and two patties each. Serve with the wedges.

recipes.title: Cauliflower and cheddar mac-style bake
recipes.blurb: Fusilli and tender cauliflower in a mustardy cheddar sauce under a golden crumb.
steps: Heat the grill to high. Cook the fusilli in boiling salted water for 7 minutes, adding the cauliflower for the last 4 minutes. Drain.
Melt the butter in a saucepan, add the garlic and stir for 20 seconds, then the flour. Cook for 1 minute, stirring.
Add the milk a splash at a time, whisking, then simmer for 4 to 5 minutes until the sauce coats a spoon. Off the heat, stir in three quarters of the cheddar, the mustard, salt and pepper.
Fold the pasta and cauliflower into the sauce and tip into an ovenproof dish. Scatter over the tomatoes.
Mix the rest of the cheddar with the panko and paprika, sprinkle on top and grill for 5 to 6 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.title: Fiery Cajun prawn and rice skillet
recipes.blurb: Hot, smoky prawns cooked with peppers, celery and rice in one pan, finished with lemon.
steps: Toss the prawns with half the Cajun seasoning and the chilli flakes. Set aside.
Heat the oil in a large lidded frying pan. Cook the onion, peppers and celery for 8 minutes until soft. Add the garlic and remaining Cajun seasoning and stir for 1 minute.
Stir in the rice, tomatoes, red chilli and 300 ml of water with the crumbled stock cube. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook on a low heat for 12 minutes.
Nestle the prawns into the rice, cover again and cook for 5 minutes until the prawns are pink and the rice is tender, adding a splash of water if it looks dry.
Season, squeeze over the lemon and scatter with spring onions and parsley.

recipes.title: BBQ chicken, corn and potato traybake
recipes.blurb: Sticky barbecue chicken thighs roasted with corn, baby potatoes and peppers, with lemony yoghurt.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Put the potatoes on a large tray with half the oil and a pinch of salt and roast for 10 minutes.
Mix the barbecue sauce, paprika and garlic with the chicken. Add the chicken, corn, onion and pepper to the tray with the remaining oil and toss.
Roast for 25 minutes, turning once, until the chicken is cooked through and sticky and the potatoes are golden.
Stir a squeeze of lemon juice, a little zest and the spring onions into the yoghurt with salt and pepper.
Serve the traybake straight from the tray with the lemony yoghurt.

recipes.title: Smoky BBQ chickpea and sweet potato bowl
recipes.blurb: Roasted barbecue chickpeas and sweet potato over quinoa with red cabbage slaw and avocado.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the sweet potato with 15 ml of the oil, half the paprika, salt and pepper on a large tray and roast for 15 minutes.
Toss the chickpeas with the barbecue sauce and the rest of the paprika, add to the tray and roast for 15 minutes more until sticky and crisp at the edges.
Meanwhile, simmer the quinoa in 300 ml of salted water for 12 to 15 minutes until the water is absorbed, then fluff with a fork.
Toss the cabbage and carrot with half the lime juice, the remaining oil and a pinch of salt.
Divide the quinoa and spinach between bowls, top with the sweet potato, chickpeas, slaw and avocado, and squeeze over the remaining lime.

recipes.title: Black bean burgers with lime slaw
recipes.blurb: Smoky black bean and oat patties in brioche buns with avocado and crunchy yoghurt slaw.
steps: Mash the beans in a bowl, leaving some whole for texture. Mix in the oats, onion, garlic, paprika, cumin, chilli powder, egg, salt and pepper until it holds together.
Shape into 2 fat patties and chill for 10 minutes to firm up.
Mix the cabbage, carrot, yoghurt, lime juice and coriander for the slaw and season.
Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Cook the patties for 5 minutes each side until crisp and heated through, turning carefully.
Toast the buns, then build with slaw, avocado and a patty.

recipes.title: Jerk chicken with coconut rice and peas
recipes.blurb: Hot, fragrant jerk-marinated chicken thighs with creamy coconut rice and kidney beans.
steps: Blitz or mash the ginger, garlic, half the spring onions, chilli, thyme, cinnamon, pepper, sugar, soy sauce, lime juice and oil into a rough paste. Rub it all over the chicken and leave for at least 15 minutes.
Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Roast the chicken on a tray for 25 to 30 minutes, turning once, until cooked through and charred in places.

Meanwhile, rinse the rice. Put it in a pan with the coconut milk, 150 ml of water, the kidney beans, the remaining spring onions and the salt. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 12 minutes.
Take the rice off the heat and leave it covered for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Rest the chicken for 3 minutes, slice and serve over the rice and peas.

recipes.title: Jerk sweet potato and kidney bean coconut stew
recipes.blurb: Sweet potato and kidney beans simmered in jerk-spiced coconut broth with spinach, served over rice.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and cook the onion and pepper for 6 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger, chilli, thyme, cinnamon and black pepper and stir for 1 minute.
Add the sweet potato, kidney beans, coconut milk, 200 ml of water and the crumbled stock cube. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook for 18 to 20 minutes until the sweet potato is tender.
Meanwhile, cook the rice in boiling salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain.
Stir the spinach into the stew until wilted, then add the lime juice and salt to taste. Crush a few pieces of sweet potato to thicken it if you like.
Serve the stew over the rice.

recipes.title: Jerk salmon with mango salsa and rice
recipes.blurb: Spiced, sticky salmon fillets with a bright mango and red onion salsa and jasmine rice.
steps: Mix the garlic, ginger, half the chilli, thyme, cinnamon, sugar, soy sauce, the juice of ½ lime and half the oil. Spread over the salmon and leave for 10 minutes.
Cook the rice in boiling salted water for 10 to 12 minutes, then drain. Stir through the spring onions.
Mix the mango, red onion, coriander, the remaining chilli and the juice of 1 lime with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Heat the remaining oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium-high heat and cook the salmon skin-side down for 4 minutes, then flip for 2 to 3 minutes until just cooked through and glazed.
Serve the salmon on the rice with the mango salsa and a wedge of the remaining lime.

recipes.title: Caribbean coconut chickpea and squash curry
recipes.blurb: Creamy, mildly spiced curry of butternut squash and chickpeas with spinach and lime.

ingredients.name: Butternut squash
ingredients.prep: peeled and cut into 2 cm chunks

steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and soften the onion for 6 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger, curry powder, thyme and half the chilli and stir for 1 minute.
Add the squash, chickpeas, coconut milk, 100 ml of water and the crumbled stock cube. Bring to a simmer and cook, partly covered, for 20 minutes until the squash is soft.
Meanwhile, cook the rice in boiling salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain.
Stir the spinach into the curry until wilted, then add the lime juice and salt to taste.
Serve over the rice, topped with the coriander and the remaining chilli.

recipes.title: Buttermilk pancakes with maple and berries
recipes.blurb: Tall, tender pancakes with a tang from buttermilk, stacked with warm berries and a good pour of maple.
steps: Melt 20 g of the butter and leave it to cool slightly. Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt together in a large bowl.
Beat the buttermilk and egg together, then stir in the melted butter. Pour into the dry ingredients and fold gently until just combined; a few lumps are fine, and the batter should be thick.
Tip the berries into a small pan with half the maple syrup and warm over a medium heat for 3–4 minutes, until they soften and turn syrupy.

Heat a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat and rub with a little of the remaining butter. Drop in 60 ml dollops of batter and cook for 2–3 minutes, until bubbles appear on top and the underside is golden.
Flip and cook for another 1–2 minutes. Keep warm in a low oven while you cook the rest, adding butter to the pan as needed.
Stack the pancakes, spoon over the warm berries and finish with the rest of the maple syrup.

recipes.title: Bacon and potato hash with fried eggs
recipes.blurb: Crisp potatoes, onion and smoky bacon fried together in one pan and topped with runny-yolked eggs.
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 5 minutes, then drain well and let them steam dry for a couple of minutes.
Fry the bacon in a large non-stick frying pan over a medium heat for 5 minutes until crisp. Lift out with a slotted spoon, leaving the fat in the pan.
Add the oil to the pan and turn the heat to medium-high. Tip in the potatoes and leave them for 5 minutes without stirring, then turn and cook for another 5 minutes, until golden.
Stir in the onion, green pepper and paprika and cook for 5 minutes, until the vegetables are soft and the potatoes are crisp. Return the bacon and season with salt and pepper.
Make a gap in the hash for each egg and crack them in. Cover and cook for 2–3 minutes until the whites are set, then scatter over the parsley.

recipes.title: Denver omelette with ham, pepper and cheddar
recipes.blurb: A fluffy folded omelette packed with diced ham, sweet peppers and onion and a layer of melted cheddar.
steps: Melt half the butter in a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat and soften the onion and green pepper for 5 minutes. Stir in the ham for the last minute, then tip the filling onto a plate.
Beat the eggs with the milk, salt and pepper until evenly mixed.
Wipe out the pan, melt half the remaining butter over a medium heat and pour in half the eggs. Stir briefly with a spatula, then leave for 1–2 minutes until just set with a slightly creamy top.
Scatter half the filling and half the cheddar over one side, fold the other side over and slide onto a plate.
Repeat with the remaining butter, eggs, filling and cheddar to make the second omelette.

recipes.title: Peanut butter and berry overnight oats
recipes.blurb: Creamy oat milk oats left to soften overnight, swirled with peanut butter and topped with berries.
steps: Mix the oats, oat milk, cinnamon and half the maple syrup in a bowl until evenly combined.
Divide between jars or bowls, cover and chill for at least 4 hours or overnight. Spread the frozen berries over the top so they thaw into a juicy sauce as the oats set.
In the morning, loosen the oats with a splash more oat milk if they have thickened too much.
Warm the peanut butter for 15 seconds in the microwave so it pours, then swirl it over the oats with the remaining maple syrup and top with the banana.

recipes.title: Green smoothie bowl with banana and pineapple
recipes.blurb: Spinach, banana and pineapple blended thick and cold, topped with oats and pumpkin seeds for crunch.
steps: Blend half the banana slices, the spinach, three-quarters of the pineapple, the oat milk and half the lime juice until thick and smooth, scraping down the sides as needed. Add a splash more oat milk only if it will not blend.
Toast the oats and pumpkin seeds in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 2–3 minutes until lightly golden, then tip onto a plate.
Pour the smoothie into bowls. It should be thick enough to hold a spoon.
Top with the remaining banana slices, the remaining pineapple, the toasted oats and seeds, and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.title: Maple oatmeal with pan-fried cinnamon apple
recipes.blurb: Creamy oats finished with maple, topped with apple fried in butter and cinnamon until caramelised.
steps: Melt the butter in a frying pan over a medium heat and fry the apple slices for 5–6 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden at the edges and soft.
Stir in half the cinnamon and half the maple syrup and cook for 1 minute until sticky, then take off the heat.
Meanwhile, put the oats, milk, a pinch of salt and the remaining cinnamon in a saucepan over a medium heat. Simmer for 5–6 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Stir the rest of the maple syrup into the oats and spoon into bowls.
Pile the apple on top, spoon over the pan juices and scatter with the walnuts.

recipes.title: Maple bacon and egg breakfast buns
recipes.blurb: Bacon glazed with a little maple syrup, tucked into a toasted bun with a fried egg and melted cheddar.
steps: Fry the bacon in a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat for 5 minutes, turning once, until nearly crisp.
Drizzle the maple syrup over the bacon and cook for another minute, turning to coat, until glossy and sticky. Lift out onto a plate.
Toast the buns cut-side down in a dry pan until golden, then spread the bottoms with the butter and the tops with the Dijon.
Crack the eggs into the bacon pan and fry for 2–3 minutes until the whites are set. Lay the cheddar over for the last 30 seconds so it melts.
Build each bun with three rashers of bacon and a cheesy egg, and press the tops on.

recipes.title: Huevos rancheros on corn tortillas
recipes.blurb: Crisp corn tortillas topped with black beans, fried eggs and a warm chilli-tomato sauce.
steps: Heat 15 ml of the oil in a saucepan over a medium heat. Fry the onion for 4 minutes, then add the garlic, chilli and cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and a pinch of salt and simmer for 8 minutes until thickened. Stir in the black beans and warm through for 2 minutes.
Meanwhile, fry the tortillas one at a time in a dry or lightly oiled frying pan over a medium-high heat for about 1 minute each side until crisp at the edges but still bendy. Keep warm on a plate.
Wipe out the pan, heat the remaining oil and fry the eggs over a medium heat for 2–3 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks still runny.
Put two tortillas on each plate, spoon over the bean sauce, top with the eggs and finish with coriander and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.title: Green chilaquiles-style eggs
recipes.blurb: Tortilla chips softened in a bright jalapeno and coriander sauce, topped with fried eggs, sour cream and feta.
steps: Blend the jalapenos, chilli, most of the coriander, 2 of the spring onions, the garlic, half the lime juice, 100 ml of water and the salt until smooth.
Heat half the oil in a wide frying pan over a medium heat. Pour in the green sauce and simmer for 3–4 minutes until slightly reduced.
Add the tortilla chips and fold them through the sauce for 1–2 minutes, until they are coated and just starting to soften but still have some bite. Divide between plates.
Wipe out the pan, heat the remaining oil and fry the eggs over a medium heat for 2–3 minutes until the whites are set.
Top the chips with the eggs, spoonfuls of sour cream, the feta, the remaining spring onion, sliced, and a little coriander. Serve with the remaining lime in wedges.

recipes.title: Rye toast with egg, cucumber and dill
recipes.blurb: Buttered rye topped with sliced soft-boiled egg, cool cucumber, radish and plenty of fresh dill.
steps: Lower the eggs into a pan of boiling water and cook for 7 minutes for a soft, just-set yolk. Cool under cold running water, then peel and slice.
While the eggs cook, toss the cucumber and radish with a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt.
Butter the rye slices generously.
Arrange the egg slices on the rye, then pile on the cucumber and radish.
Scatter over the dill, finish with a grind of black pepper and a little lemon zest, and serve right away.

recipes.title: Swedish-style yoghurt with lingonberry and oats
recipes.blurb: Cool, tangy yoghurt with toasted oats, tart lingonberry jam and almonds, no cooking needed beyond a quick toast.
steps: Toast the oats and flaked almonds in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 3 minutes, stirring, until golden and fragrant. Stir in the cinnamon and tip into a bowl to cool.
Stir the honey into the yoghurt to take the edge off the tang.
Spoon the yoghurt into bowls.
Top with the lingonberry jam and the toasted oat and almond mixture.

recipes.title: Danish-style rye bread porridge with apple
recipes.blurb: Stale rye simmered in milk with a little brown sugar and cinnamon, finished with cool yoghurt and fresh apple.

ingredients.name: Apple
ingredients.prep: cored and cut into thin matchsticks

steps: Put the torn rye bread in a saucepan with the milk, brown sugar, cinnamon and salt. Leave to soak for 5 minutes.
Bring to a gentle simmer over a medium-low heat and cook for 8–10 minutes, stirring often and mashing with a wooden spoon, until the bread breaks down into a thick, dark porridge.
Add a splash more milk if it gets too stiff; it should be like a loose, spoonable mash.
Spoon into bowls and top with the yoghurt and the apple matchsticks.

recipes.title: Turkish eggs with garlic yoghurt and chilli butter
recipes.blurb: Soft poached eggs on cool garlicky yoghurt, drizzled with sizzling paprika butter and scooped up with toast.
steps: Stir the garlic and a pinch of salt into the yoghurt, then divide between shallow bowls and leave at room temperature.
Bring a wide pan of water to a gentle simmer and add the vinegar. Swirl the water and slide in the eggs, then poach for 3 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks are soft.
While the eggs cook, toast the sourdough.
Melt the butter in a small pan over a medium heat until foaming, then stir in the paprika and chilli flakes and take off the heat after 20 seconds.
Lift the eggs out with a slotted spoon, drain briefly and set them on the yoghurt.
Spoon over the chilli butter, scatter with dill and serve with the toast for scooping.

recipes.title: Labneh-style yoghurt toast with za'atar
recipes.blurb: Thick lemony yoghurt spread on crisp sourdough with cucumber, tomatoes, mint and a shower of za'atar.
steps: Beat the yoghurt with a pinch of salt and a squeeze of lemon juice until thick and smooth. Leave for a few minutes if you can.
Toast the sourdough until deeply golden and crisp at the edges.
Toss the tomatoes and cucumber with half the oil, a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt.
Spread the yoghurt thickly over the toast, making a few swoops with the back of a spoon.
Pile on the salad, scatter over the za'atar and mint, and drizzle with the remaining oil.

recipes.title: Menemen with peppers and tomato
recipes.blurb: Turkish-style soft eggs scrambled into stewed peppers and tomato, with chilli flakes and bread for mopping.
steps: Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat. Fry the onion and green pepper with a pinch of salt for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the tomatoes and chilli flakes and cook for 5–6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they break down into a thick, jammy sauce.
Make a well in the sauce for each egg and crack them in. Stir gently with a fork to break up the yolks and swirl them through the sauce, and cook for 2–3 minutes until just set but still soft.
Meanwhile, toast the sourdough.
Scatter the parsley over the pan and serve straight from it with the toast alongside.

recipes.title: Savoury rice porridge with egg and ginger
recipes.blurb: Silky congee-style rice porridge, finished with soy, sesame oil, ginger and a soft-boiled egg.
steps: Rinse the rice under cold water until it runs clear, then put it in a large saucepan with 1000 ml of water, the stock cube, half the ginger and the salt.

Bring to the boil, then reduce to a low simmer and cook uncovered for 30 minutes, stirring every few minutes towards the end so it does not catch, until the rice has broken down into a creamy porridge. Add a splash of boiling water if it gets too thick.
Ten minutes before the end, lower the eggs into a separate pan of boiling water for 7 minutes, then cool under cold water and peel.
Stir the soy sauce and half the sesame oil into the congee and divide between bowls.
Halve the eggs over the top and finish with the remaining ginger, the spring onions, the remaining sesame oil and the chilli oil.

recipes.title: Tamagoyaki-style egg rice bowl
recipes.blurb: Layered sweet-savoury rolled omelette over warm rice with spring onion, sesame and a splash of soy.
steps: Rinse the rice, then cook it in a covered pan with 280 ml of water: bring to the boil, turn the heat right down and cook for 12 minutes, then rest off the heat for 5 minutes.
Whisk the eggs with the mirin, half the soy sauce and the sugar until just combined.
Heat a little of the oil in a small non-stick frying pan over a medium-low heat. Pour in a thin layer of egg, let it set and bubble for 30 seconds, then roll it up from one side to the other.
Slide the roll to the edge, add a little more oil and egg, lift the roll to let the egg run underneath and roll again. Repeat until the egg is used up.
Slide the omelette onto a board and slice into thick pieces.
Spoon the rice into bowls, top with the egg and cucumber and drizzle with the remaining soy sauce. Scatter with the spring onions and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Masala omelette with toast
recipes.blurb: A spiced Indian-style omelette with onion, green chilli, tomato and coriander, served with buttered toast.
steps: Beat the eggs in a bowl with the onion, chilli, tomato, half the coriander, turmeric, garam masala and salt until well combined.
Heat half the oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Pour in half the mixture and tilt to spread it thinly.
Cook for 2 minutes until the base is set and golden, then flip and cook for another minute. Slide onto a plate.
Repeat with the remaining oil and egg mixture to make a second omelette.
Toast and butter the bread, and serve the omelettes with the remaining coriander scattered over.

recipes.title: Upma-style couscous with veg and cashews
recipes.blurb: Fluffy savoury couscous cooked the South Indian upma way, with mustard seeds, curry leaves, ginger, peas and cashews.
steps: Toast the couscous in a dry pan over a medium heat for 2 minutes until it smells nutty, then tip it into a bowl.
Heat the oil in the pan over a medium heat. Add the mustard seeds, curry leaves and cashews and cook for 1 minute, until the seeds pop, the leaves crackle and the cashews turn golden.
Add the onion, chilli, ginger and carrot and cook for 5–6 minutes until the onion is soft and the carrot is just tender.
Add the peas and 260 ml of boiling water with the salt. Return the couscous to the pan, stir once, cover and take off the heat for 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork, squeeze over lemon juice to taste and finish with the coriander.

recipes.title: Smoked mackerel kedgeree-style rice and eggs
recipes.blurb: Gently curried rice with flaked smoked mackerel, peas and soft-boiled eggs, brightened with lemon and parsley.
steps: Lower the eggs into a pan of boiling water and cook for 7 minutes, then cool under cold water, peel and quarter.
Melt the butter in a lidded saucepan over a medium heat and soften the onion for 5 minutes. Stir in the curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the rice, stirring to coat, then pour in 280 ml of boiling water and the salt. Cover and simmer very gently for 10 minutes.
Scatter the peas over the rice, cover again and cook for 3 more minutes, then take off the heat and leave covered for 5 minutes.
Fork the flaked mackerel through the rice with the parsley, a squeeze of lemon and plenty of black pepper.
Top with the egg quarters and serve with the rest of the lemon cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Garlic thyme mushrooms on toast
recipes.blurb: Golden chestnut mushrooms fried with garlic and thyme, piled on thick sourdough toast with a splash of soy.
steps: Heat half the oil in a large frying pan over a high heat. Add the mushrooms in a single layer and leave for 3 minutes without stirring, until golden underneath.
Stir and cook for another 4 minutes until browned all over and the liquid has evaporated.
Add the remaining oil, garlic and thyme and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant but not burnt.
Splash in the soy sauce and a grind of black pepper, and toss for 20 seconds.
Toast the sourdough, pile the mushrooms on top and scatter with the parsley.

recipes.title: Full English-style breakfast traybake
recipes.blurb: Sausages, bacon, mushrooms, tomatoes and eggs roasted on one tray, with baked beans warmed alongside.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Put the sausages on a large tray, drizzle with half the oil and roast for 10 minutes.
Turn the sausages and add the tomatoes, cut-side up, and the mushrooms. Drizzle with the remaining oil, season with salt and pepper, then lay the bacon over the top and roast for 12 minutes.
Push everything to the sides to make a gap for each egg and crack them in. Roast for 4–5 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks are still soft.
Meanwhile, warm the baked beans in a small saucepan over a low heat for 4–5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Toast the bread and butter it. Serve straight from the tray with the beans and toast.

recipes.title: Tofu scramble and spinach breakfast wraps
recipes.blurb: Turmeric-yellow crumbled tofu with peppers and spinach, wrapped warm with avocado and a kick of hot sauce.
steps: Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the red pepper for 4 minutes until it starts to soften, adding the spring onions for the last minute.
Crumble the tofu into the pan with your hands. Add the turmeric, smoked paprika and salt and cook for 5 minutes, stirring, until the tofu is hot and lightly golden.
Add the spinach and stir for 1 minute until wilted.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or the microwave for 20 seconds each.
Spoon the scramble onto the tortillas, top with the avocado and hot sauce, fold in the sides and roll up.

recipes.title: Leek and mushroom puff pastry pie
recipes.blurb: Soft leeks and browned mushrooms in a thyme creme fraiche sauce under a crisp, golden pastry lid.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Melt the butter in a wide, ovenproof frying pan over a medium-high heat and fry the mushrooms for 6 minutes without moving them too much, until deeply browned.
Add the leeks, garlic and thyme with a pinch of salt and cook for 6–8 minutes until the leeks have collapsed and turned silky.

Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then pour in the stock a splash at a time. Simmer for 2 minutes, then take off the heat and stir through the creme fraiche, mustard and plenty of pepper. Let it cool for a few minutes.
Unroll the pastry and lay it over the pan, tucking the edges in against the sides. Cut a small slit in the centre, brush with beaten egg and bake for 20–22 minutes until puffed and deep golden.
Ten minutes before the pie is ready, boil the green beans for 4–5 minutes until just tender and drain well.
Rest the pie for 3 minutes, then serve in wedges with the buttered beans.

recipes.title: Sausages with buttery mash and onion gravy
recipes.blurb: Browned pork sausages on creamy mash with sweet onion gravy and a heap of peas.
steps: Put the potatoes in a pan of cold salted water, bring to the boil and simmer for 15–18 minutes until a knife slides through with no resistance.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat and cook the sausages for 14–16 minutes, turning often, until evenly browned and cooked through. Lift out onto a plate.
Add the onions to the sausage fat with a pinch of salt and cook for 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until soft and golden.
Stir the flour and mustard into the onions for 1 minute, then pour in the stock gradually. Simmer for 5 minutes until glossy and thick enough to coat a spoon.
Drain the potatoes, return to the warm pan and mash with the butter, milk, salt and pepper until smooth. Boil the peas for 3 minutes in a separate pan.
Serve the mash with the sausages, peas and a generous pour of onion gravy.

recipes.title: Salmon and dill fishcakes with a lemony pea salad
recipes.blurb: Crisp-crumbed salmon and potato cakes with a bright pea and leaf salad and caper creme fraiche.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15 minutes until tender, drain and leave to steam dry for 5 minutes, then mash roughly.
Season the salmon, wrap it loosely in foil and bake for 10–12 minutes until just cooked. Flake the flesh away from the skin and discard the skin.
Fold the salmon through the mash with the spring onions, dill, the zest of half the lemon and a good grind of pepper. Shape into 4 thick patties.
Dip each patty in the flour, then the beaten egg, then the panko. Fry in the vegetable oil over a medium heat for 3–4 minutes each side until crisp and golden.
Cook the peas in boiling water for 3 minutes, drain, then toss with the salad leaves, olive oil and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Stir the capers and a little lemon zest into the creme fraiche. Serve the fishcakes with the pea salad, the caper sauce and the remaining lemon in wedges.

recipes.title: Crispy cod with crushed potatoes and caper peas
recipes.blurb: Oven-crisp panko fish on buttery crushed baby potatoes with caper peas and a lemony creme fraiche dip.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan) and put a baking tray in to heat. Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15–18 minutes until tender.
Mix the panko with the vegetable oil and a pinch of salt. Cut the fish into 2 pieces, season, then coat in flour, beaten egg and the oily crumbs, pressing firmly.
Slide the fish onto the hot tray and bake for 12–14 minutes until the crumb is golden and the fish flakes easily.
Drain the potatoes, tip them back into the pan with the olive oil, the zest of half the lemon and the parsley, and crush each one lightly with a fork. Season well.
Boil the peas for 3 minutes, drain, and stir through the capers and a squeeze of lemon.
Stir some lemon zest and juice into the creme fraiche. Serve the fish with the potatoes, peas and the dip.

recipes.title: Lentil and mushroom cottage pie
recipes.blurb: Rich puy lentil and mushroom filling under a golden olive oil mash, with peas on the side.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15–18 minutes until completely tender.
Meanwhile, heat 15 ml of the oil in a large pan and cook the onion, carrots and mushrooms over a medium-high heat for 8–10 minutes until the mushrooms have given up their water and started to brown.
Add the garlic, thyme and tomato puree and stir for 1 minute. Tip in the lentils, balsamic and stock and simmer for 8 minutes until thick and saucy. Season well and spoon into a baking dish.
Drain the potatoes and mash with the remaining oil, the oat drink, salt and pepper until smooth. Spread over the filling and rough up the top with a fork.
Bake for 20 minutes until the edges are bubbling and the peaks of mash are golden. Boil the peas for 3 minutes just before serving.
Rest the pie for 5 minutes and serve with the peas.

recipes.title: Chicken and leek pie with buttery kale
recipes.blurb: Tender chicken and leeks in a creamy mustard sauce under flaky puff pastry, with garlicky kale.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Melt 15 g of the butter in an ovenproof pan over a medium-high heat and brown the chicken for 4–5 minutes, seasoning as it cooks. Lift out.
Add the leeks and thyme to the pan with a pinch of salt and cook gently for 6 minutes until soft.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then gradually add the stock. Simmer for 2 minutes, then return the chicken, stir in the creme fraiche and mustard and take off the heat.
Cover with the pastry, tucking in the edges, cut a slit in the middle and brush with egg. Bake for 20–22 minutes until risen and deep golden.
For the last 5 minutes, melt the remaining butter in a frying pan, fry the garlic for 30 seconds, add the kale with a splash of water and cook until wilted and tender.
Serve wedges of pie with the buttery kale.

recipes.title: Smoked mackerel and new potato salad
recipes.blurb: Flaky smoked mackerel, warm baby potatoes, crunchy radish and cucumber in a dill and mustard dressing.
steps: Boil the potatoes in well-salted water for 12–15 minutes until tender, then drain and leave to steam for a couple of minutes.
While they cook, whisk the creme fraiche, mustard, olive oil, the zest and juice of half the lemon, half the dill and a good pinch of pepper into a loose dressing.
Toss the warm potatoes with about half the dressing so they soak it up.
Arrange the salad leaves, cucumber, radish and spring onions on plates and top with the potatoes and flaked mackerel.
Spoon over the rest of the dressing, scatter with the remaining dill and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Cheddar rarebit toasts with blistered tomatoes
recipes.blurb: Thick sourdough under a bubbling mustardy cheddar topping, with sweet blistered tomatoes and wilted spinach.
steps: Heat the grill to high. Toast the sourdough on both sides on a baking tray until just golden.
Beat the cheddar with the creme fraiche, mustard, flour, egg yolk and plenty of black pepper into a thick paste.
Spread the paste generously right to the edges of the toast and grill for 3–4 minutes until bubbling and flecked with brown.
Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a frying pan over a high heat and cook the tomatoes for 4 minutes until blistered and starting to burst. Add the balsamic and a pinch of salt.
Add the spinach and let it wilt for 1 minute.
Serve the rarebit toasts with the tomatoes and spinach, scattered with chives.

recipes.title: Shepherd's pie with parsnip mash
recipes.blurb: Rosemary lamb and vegetable mince under a sweet parsnip and potato mash with a cheddar crust.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Boil the potatoes and parsnips together in salted water for 15–18 minutes until very tender.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large pan over a high heat and brown the lamb for 5 minutes, breaking it up. Add the onion, carrot and celery and cook for 6 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, rosemary, tomato puree and flour for 1 minute, then add the stock. Simmer for 10 minutes until thick, stir in the peas and season well. Spoon into a baking dish.
Drain the potatoes and parsnips and mash with the butter, milk, salt and pepper.
Spread the mash over the lamb, rough up the top with a fork and scatter with the cheddar.
Bake for 18–20 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges, and rest for 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Mustard roast roots with butter beans and kale
recipes.blurb: Caramelised carrots, parsnips and red onion roasted with rosemary, butter beans and a sharp mustard dressing.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the carrots, parsnips and red onion on a large tray with 25 ml of the oil, the rosemary, salt and pepper.
Roast for 25 minutes, turning once, until golden at the edges and tender.
Add the butter beans and kale to the tray, drizzle with a little more oil and roast for a final 8–10 minutes until the kale is crisp at the tips and the beans are warm.
Whisk the mustard, vinegar, maple syrup and remaining oil with a pinch of salt.
Scatter the walnuts over the tray, drizzle with the dressing and serve straight away.

recipes.title: Peppercorn steak with oven chips and green beans
recipes.blurb: Seared rump steak in a creamy cracked-pepper and shallot sauce, with crisp oven chips and buttery beans.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the chips on a large tray with 20 ml of the oil and a good pinch of salt, and roast for 30–35 minutes, turning halfway, until crisp and golden.
Take the steak out of the fridge 20 minutes before cooking and pat dry. Season with salt and press half the cracked pepper into both sides.
Heat the remaining oil in a heavy frying pan over a high heat. Sear the steak for 3 minutes each side for medium-rare, then rest on a plate.
Lower the heat, add the butter and shallot to the pan and cook for 2 minutes. Stir in the remaining pepper, stock and mustard, then simmer for 3 minutes until reduced by half.
Add the cream and any steak resting juices and simmer for 2 minutes until the sauce coats a spoon.
Boil the green beans for 4 minutes and drain. Slice the steak, and serve with the sauce, chips, beans and parsley.

recipes.title: Leek and potato gratin with a mustard leaf salad
recipes.blurb: Thin-sliced potatoes and leeks baked in garlicky cream under a golden cheese crust, with a sharp salad.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and butter a medium baking dish. Warm the cream, milk, garlic, thyme, half the salt and plenty of pepper in a pan until just steaming.
Layer the potatoes and leeks in the dish, seasoning each layer lightly with salt.
Pour over the warm cream mixture, pressing the layers down so they are mostly submerged. Cover tightly with foil.
Bake covered for 30 minutes, then uncover, scatter over the cheddar and parmesan, and bake for 15–18 minutes more until deep golden and the potatoes are completely tender.
Whisk the mustard, vinegar and olive oil with a pinch of salt and toss with the salad leaves.
Let the gratin settle for 5 minutes, then serve with the salad.

recipes.title: Goats' cheese, beetroot and walnut bistro salad
recipes.blurb: Warm honeyed goats' cheese toasts on peppery leaves with beetroot, green beans and toasted walnuts.
steps: Heat the grill to high. Boil the green beans for 4 minutes, drain and refresh under cold water.
Whisk the shallot, mustard, vinegar and 20 ml of the olive oil with a pinch of salt and pepper to make a dressing.
Toast the baguette slices under the grill on one side. Turn them over, top each with a little goats' cheese, drizzle with honey and grill for 2–3 minutes until bubbling and lightly browned.
Toast the walnuts in a dry frying pan for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Toss the leaves, beans and beetroot with most of the dressing and divide between plates.
Top with the warm goats' cheese toasts, scatter over the walnuts and chives, and drizzle with the remaining dressing and oil.

recipes.title: French onion soup with cheesy baguette toasts
recipes.blurb: Slow-cooked sweet onions in a thyme broth, topped with bubbling cheese on crusty baguette.
steps: Melt the butter with the oil in a large, heavy pan over a medium heat. Add the onions and a pinch of salt and cook for 25–30 minutes, stirring every few minutes, until deep golden brown and jammy.
Add the garlic and thyme for 1 minute, then stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute more.
Pour in the stock gradually, stirring, then add the balsamic and mustard. Simmer for 10 minutes and season with pepper.
Heat the grill. Toast the baguette slices on one side, turn, and cover with the cheddar and parmesan. Grill for 2–3 minutes until bubbling and flecked with brown.
Ladle the soup into bowls and float the cheesy toasts on top.

recipes.title: Provencal ratatouille with white beans and crusty bread
recipes.blurb: Aubergine, courgette and peppers stewed in tomato and thyme with creamy cannellini and basil.
steps: Heat half the oil in a large, wide pan over a medium-high heat and fry the aubergine for 8 minutes, stirring often, until golden and softened. Tip onto a plate.
Add the remaining oil and the onion, peppers and courgette and cook for 8 minutes until beginning to soften and catch at the edges.
Stir in the garlic, thyme and tomato puree for 1 minute, then add the chopped tomatoes, a splash of water, the aubergine and a good pinch of salt.
Simmer gently for 15 minutes, stirring now and then, until the vegetables are tender and the sauce has thickened.
Stir through the cannellini beans, olives and balsamic and warm through for 3 minutes. Season to taste.
Serve topped with torn basil and the warm baguette.

recipes.title: Creamy mustard chicken with mushrooms and baby potatoes
recipes.blurb: Pan-seared chicken in a thyme, mustard and creme fraiche sauce with browned mushrooms and green beans.
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 12–15 minutes until tender, adding the green beans for the last 4 minutes. Drain and toss with half the butter.
Meanwhile, season the chicken and heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Cook for 4–5 minutes each side until golden and cooked through, then lift onto a plate.
Add the remaining butter and the mushrooms to the pan and fry for 5 minutes until browned. Add the garlic and thyme for 30 seconds.
Pour in the stock and bubble for 3 minutes, then stir in the creme fraiche and mustard and simmer for 2 minutes until silky.
Return the chicken and its juices to the sauce for a minute. Serve with the potatoes, beans and a scatter of parsley.

recipes.title: Hungarian-style beef and paprika goulash
recipes.blurb: Beef and peppers slowly simmered in smoky paprika and tomato with potatoes, finished with creme fraiche.

ingredients.name: White potatoes
ingredients.prep: peeled and cut into 2 cm chunks

steps: Heat the oil in a large casserole or deep pan over a high heat. Season the beef and brown it in two batches for 2–3 minutes each, then lift out.
Lower the heat to medium, add the onions with a pinch of salt and cook for 8 minutes until soft and golden.
Stir in the garlic, both paprikas and the tomato puree for 1 minute. Take care not to let the paprika scorch, as it turns bitter.

Add the chopped tomatoes, stock, bay leaf, peppers, potatoes and the beef with its juices. Bring to the boil, then cover and simmer gently for 30 minutes, stirring now and then, until the beef and potatoes are tender.
Uncover for the last 5 minutes if the sauce is thin. Season to taste and remove the bay leaf.
Serve in bowls with a spoonful of creme fraiche and chopped parsley.

recipes.title: Pork schnitzel with potato salad and apple cabbage slaw
recipes.blurb: Thin, crisp-crumbed pork with lemon, warm mustardy potatoes and a crunchy red cabbage and apple slaw.
steps: Boil the potatoes in well-salted water for 12–15 minutes until tender. Drain, toss with the butter, mustard and half the chives and keep warm.
Toss the red cabbage and apple with the vinegar, olive oil, the juice of half the lemon and a good pinch of salt, and leave to soften for 10 minutes.
Season the pork and coat each piece in flour, then beaten egg, then panko, pressing the crumbs on firmly.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat until a crumb sizzles immediately. Fry the schnitzels for 2–3 minutes each side until deep golden, in batches if needed.
Drain on kitchen paper and sprinkle with a pinch of salt.
Serve with lemon wedges, the warm potatoes and the slaw, sprinkled with the remaining chives.

recipes.title: Nordic dill and mustard salmon with a cucumber pickle
recipes.blurb: Honey-mustard glazed salmon with dill baby potatoes and a quick sweet-sharp cucumber and radish pickle.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Boil the potatoes in salted water for 12–15 minutes until tender.
Stir the vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt together until dissolved, then toss with the cucumber and radish and leave to pickle while everything cooks.
Mix the mustard and honey and spread over the salmon. Place on a lined tray, drizzle with the oil and roast for 10–12 minutes until just cooked and flaking.
Stir half the dill, the chives, a little lemon zest and juice and a pinch of salt into the creme fraiche.
Drain the potatoes and toss with the remaining dill and pepper.
Serve the salmon on the potatoes with the pickle and herb creme fraiche, plus lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Portuguese-style paprika chicken and potato traybake
recipes.blurb: Chicken thighs roasted with garlic, lemon, smoked paprika and chilli over crisp potatoes, with a tomato salad.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Mix 20 ml of the oil with both paprikas, the chilli flakes, the zest and juice of half the lemon, and a good pinch of salt and pepper.
Toss the chicken and potatoes in the spiced oil on a large tray, then scatter over the onion, pepper and garlic cloves.
Roast for 35–40 minutes, turning everything once halfway, until the chicken is cooked through and the potatoes are crisp and rust-coloured.
Toss the tomatoes and cucumber with the vinegar, remaining oil and a pinch of salt.
Squeeze the remaining lemon over the tray, scatter with parsley and serve with the salad.

recipes.title: Beetroot and cabbage soup with dill creme fraiche
recipes.blurb: A ruby, sweet-sour Eastern European-style soup of beetroot, potato and cabbage, swirled with dill creme fraiche.

ingredients.name: White potatoes
ingredients.prep: peeled and cut into small cubes

steps: Heat the oil in a large pan over a medium heat and cook the onion and carrots for 6 minutes until starting to soften. Add the garlic and tomato puree and stir for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes, beetroot, bay leaf and stock. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 12 minutes.
Stir in the cabbage and simmer for a further 8–10 minutes until everything is tender.
Add the vinegar, then taste and season with salt and pepper, adding a splash more vinegar if you want it sharper. Remove the bay leaf.
Stir half the dill into the creme fraiche. Ladle the soup into bowls, swirl in the dill creme fraiche and scatter with the remaining dill.
Serve with the bread, toasted if you like.

recipes.title: Smoky chickpea and kale stew with garlicky sourdough
recipes.blurb: Chickpeas, potato and kale in a paprika tomato broth with a hint of chilli, served with garlic-rubbed sourdough.

ingredients.name: White potatoes
ingredients.prep: peeled and cut into 2 cm chunks

steps: Heat 15 ml of the oil in a large pan over a medium heat and cook the onion for 6 minutes until soft. Add the crushed garlic, smoked paprika and chilli flakes and stir for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes, chopped tomatoes, stock and bay leaf. Bring to the boil, cover and simmer for 12 minutes.
Stir in the chickpeas and simmer, uncovered, for 8 minutes until the potatoes are tender and the broth has thickened a little. Crush a few chickpeas against the side of the pan to thicken it.
Add the kale and cook for 4–5 minutes until wilted and tender. Season with salt, pepper and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Toast the sourdough, rub with the cut garlic clove and drizzle with the remaining oil.
Ladle the stew into bowls, scatter with parsley and serve with the garlic toast.

recipes.title: Dan dan-style noodles with crispy mushrooms
recipes.blurb: Chewy noodles in a nutty, tingly chilli sauce under deeply browned mushrooms. Vegan and properly addictive.
steps: Toast the Sichuan peppercorns in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 1 minute until fragrant, then crush them finely with the back of a spoon.

Heat the oil in a wok over a high heat and fry the mushrooms for 7 to 8 minutes without stirring too often, until dry and deeply browned. Add the garlic, ginger and spring onion whites for 1 minute, then stir in the black bean sauce and a splash of the soy sauce.
In a large bowl, whisk the peanut butter, the remaining soy sauce, the vinegar, sugar, chilli oil and crushed peppercorns with 60 ml of hot water until smooth.
Boil the noodles for 3 minutes, adding the pak choi for the last minute. Drain, keeping a splash of the cooking water.
Toss the noodles and pak choi through the sauce, loosening with the cooking water if it clings too thickly.
Divide between bowls, spoon over the mushrooms and finish with the spring onion greens.

recipes.title: Fish-fragrant aubergine with rice
recipes.blurb: Silky aubergine in a sweet, sour and garlicky chilli sauce. There is no fish in it, just the classic Sichuan flavour.
steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 300 ml of water: bring to the boil, cover, turn the heat right down and cook for 12 minutes, then rest off the heat. Toss the aubergine with the salt and leave in a colander for 10 minutes, then pat dry.
Stir the soy sauce, vinegar, Shaoxing wine, sugar and cornflour with 100 ml of water in a small bowl.
Heat 2 tbsp of the oil in a wok over a high heat and fry the aubergine in two batches for 6 to 7 minutes each until golden and soft. Lift out onto a plate.
Lower the heat to medium and add the remaining oil. Fry the garlic, ginger, spring onion whites, chilli flakes and black bean sauce for 1 minute until the oil turns red.
Pour in the sauce, bubble for 1 minute, then return the aubergine and toss gently for 2 minutes until glossy.
Serve over the rice, scattered with the spring onion greens.

recipes.title: Dry-fried green beans with pork and rice
recipes.blurb: Blistered green beans and crisp pork mince with garlic, ginger and a tingle of Sichuan pepper.
steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 300 ml of water: boil, cover, turn right down and cook for 12 minutes, then rest off the heat. Crush the Sichuan peppercorns finely.
Heat half the oil in a wok over a high heat. Fry the beans with the salt, turning only now and then, for 6 to 7 minutes until blistered and wrinkled. Tip them onto a plate.
Add the remaining oil and fry the pork, breaking it up, for 4 minutes until crisp and golden at the edges.
Add the garlic, ginger, spring onion whites, chilli flakes and crushed peppercorns and stir for 30 seconds.
Pour in the soy sauce, Shaoxing wine and sugar, let it bubble for 20 seconds, then return the beans and toss until the pan is nearly dry.
Serve over the rice with the spring onion greens.

recipes.title: Kung pao-style chicken with peanuts
recipes.blurb: Sizzling chicken, roasted peanuts and a sweet, tangy, tingly sauce. Better than the takeaway version.
steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 300 ml of water: boil, cover, turn right down and cook for 12 minutes, then rest off the heat.
Toss the chicken with half the soy sauce, the Shaoxing wine and cornflour. Stir the remaining soy, the vinegar, sugar and 3 tbsp of water in a small bowl.
Toast the peanuts in a dry wok over a medium heat for 3 minutes until golden, then set aside. Crush the peppercorns.
Heat the oil in the wok over a high heat and fry the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Add the green pepper, garlic, ginger, spring onion whites, chilli flakes and peppercorns and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Pour in the sauce and bubble for 1 minute until glossy, then fold in the peanuts and serve over the rice with the spring onion greens.

recipes.title: Black bean beef with peppers
recipes.blurb: Quick-seared beef and sweet peppers in a salty, savoury black bean sauce, a Cantonese takeaway classic.
steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 300 ml of water: boil, cover, turn right down and cook for 12 minutes, then rest off the heat.
Toss the beef with the soy sauce, half the Shaoxing wine and 6 g of the cornflour. Mix the black bean sauce, sugar, remaining wine and 100 ml of water in a small bowl.
Heat half the oil in a wok over the highest heat. Sear the beef for 90 seconds until browned, then tip it onto a plate.
Add the remaining oil and stir-fry the onion and peppers for 3 minutes so they keep some bite. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Pour in the black bean mixture and return the beef. Stir the rest of the cornflour into 1 tbsp of water, add it and bubble for 1 minute until glossy.
Serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Ginger and spring onion steamed white fish
recipes.blurb: Delicate fish steamed over ginger, then drenched in hot oil and soy. Light, quick and very Cantonese.

ingredients.name: Fresh ginger
ingredients.prep: half sliced, half cut into fine matchsticks

steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 300 ml of water: boil, cover, turn right down and cook for 12 minutes, then rest off the heat.

Put an upturned heatproof bowl in a wide, lidded pan with 2 cm of water. Lay the sliced ginger on a heatproof plate, rest the fish on top, sprinkle with the salt and Shaoxing wine, and set the plate on the bowl.
Bring the water to a steady simmer, cover and steam for 8 to 10 minutes until the fish is opaque and flakes easily. Add the pak choi to the water around the plate for the last 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, stir the soy sauce with the sugar and 2 tbsp of hot water until dissolved.
Lift the fish onto a clean plate, discarding the ginger slices and liquid. Scatter the ginger matchsticks, spring onion and coriander over it.
Heat the oil in a small pan until it just starts to smoke, pour it over the fish so it sizzles, then spoon the soy mixture around. Serve with the rice and pak choi.

recipes.title: Char siu-style pork with rice and pak choi
recipes.blurb: Sticky, five-spice roast pork with charred edges, over rice with garlicky greens.
steps: Mix the hoisin, honey, 15 ml of the soy sauce, the Shaoxing wine, five-spice, two-thirds of the garlic and the ginger. Coat the pork in it and leave for 10 minutes, or longer if you have time.
Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Lay the pork on a foil-lined tray, spooning over any marinade left in the bowl.
Roast for 20 to 25 minutes, turning and basting once halfway, until sticky and charred at the edges and cooked through.
Meanwhile cook the rice in a lidded pan with 300 ml of water: boil, cover, turn right down and cook for 12 minutes, then rest off the heat.
Stir-fry the pak choi in the oil over a high heat for 2 to 3 minutes with the remaining garlic, then add the rest of the soy sauce and 2 tbsp of water for 30 seconds.
Rest the pork for 3 minutes, slice it and serve over the rice with the pak choi and the sticky tray juices.

recipes.title: Tomato and egg stir-fry with rice
recipes.blurb: Soft curds of egg in a sweet-savoury tomato sauce. The comfort dish of countless Chinese homes.
steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 300 ml of water: boil, cover, turn right down and cook for 12 minutes, then rest off the heat.
Beat the eggs with a third of the salt and 1 tbsp of water.
Heat half the oil in a wok over a high heat. Pour in the eggs and push them gently around for 30 to 40 seconds until just set in large soft curds, then lift them out.
Add the remaining oil and the spring onion whites, then the tomatoes. Cook for 4 to 5 minutes, pressing them down, until they break into a saucy mixture.
Stir in the sugar, soy sauce and the rest of the salt, then fold the eggs back in for 30 seconds.
Drizzle with the sesame oil and serve over the rice with the spring onion greens.

recipes.title: Red-braised pork-style shoulder with pak choi
recipes.blurb: Pork shoulder simmered until tender in a glossy soy, star anise and ginger sauce. Spoon it over rice.
steps: Cover the pork with cold water in a pan, bring to the boil for 2 minutes, then drain and rinse. This keeps the sauce clear and clean-tasting.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over a medium heat, add the sugar and let it melt and turn amber, about 2 minutes. Add the pork and turn it for 3 minutes to coat it in the caramel.
Add the ginger, garlic, spring onion whites and star anise for 1 minute, then pour in the soy sauce, Shaoxing wine and 350 ml of water.

Bring to a simmer, cover and cook gently for 35 minutes until the pork is tender. Meanwhile cook the rice in a lidded pan with 300 ml of water: boil, cover, turn right down and cook for 12 minutes, then rest.
Take the lid off, turn the heat up and bubble for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until the sauce is syrupy and clings to the pork.
Steam the pak choi in a splash of water for 2 minutes. Serve the pork and sauce over the rice with the pak choi and the spring onion greens.

recipes.title: Xinjiang-style cumin lamb noodles
recipes.blurb: Smoky cumin and chilli lamb with peppers and chewy noodles. Dry, fragrant and fiery.
steps: Toast the cumin seeds and Sichuan peppercorns in a dry wok for 1 minute until fragrant, then crush them coarsely and tip into a bowl with the chilli flakes.
Boil the noodles for the packet time, drain and rinse under cold water.
Heat half the oil in the wok over a high heat and fry the lamb, breaking it up, for 6 to 7 minutes until browned and crisp at the edges. Lift it out, leaving the fat behind.
Add the remaining oil and stir-fry the onion and green pepper for 3 minutes. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the lamb with the spice mix, soy sauce, vinegar and salt, and toss for 1 minute. Add the noodles and toss for 2 minutes more until coated and hot.
Serve scattered with the coriander.

recipes.title: Hot and sour soup with tofu and mushrooms
recipes.blurb: Peppery, tangy broth with silky egg ribbons, soft tofu and mushrooms, with rice on the side.
steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 200 ml of water: boil, cover, turn right down and cook for 12 minutes, then rest off the heat.
Heat the oil in a saucepan over a medium-high heat and fry the mushrooms, carrot and ginger for 4 minutes until softened.
Add 600 ml of water, the crumbled stock cube, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and black pepper. Bring to a simmer, add the tofu and cook for 3 minutes.
Mix the cornflour with 3 tbsp of cold water and stir it in. Simmer for 1 to 2 minutes until the soup thickens slightly.
Turn the heat to low and pour in the egg in a thin stream, stirring the soup gently in one direction so it forms ribbons.
Take off the heat and stir in the sesame oil and chilli oil. Ladle into bowls, top with the spring onion and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Crispy tofu chow mein with cabbage and sprouts
recipes.blurb: Springy noodles tossed with golden tofu, crunchy cabbage and bean sprouts in a savoury-sweet sauce.
steps: Cook the noodles to the packet time, drain, rinse under cold water and toss with a little of the sesame oil so they do not stick.
Stir the soy sauce, hoisin, sugar, black pepper and 2 tbsp of water together.
Heat half the vegetable oil in a wok over a high heat and fry the tofu for 5 minutes, turning, until golden on most sides. Lift it out.
Add the remaining oil and stir-fry the cabbage, carrot and spring onion whites for 3 minutes, then add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss for 2 minutes. Add the tofu, bean sprouts and spring onion greens and toss for 1 minute more.
Finish with the rest of the sesame oil.

recipes.title: Chilli oil chicken with smacked cucumber
recipes.blurb: Tender poached chicken in a tingly chilli dressing, with garlicky smacked cucumber and rice.
steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 300 ml of water: boil, cover, turn right down and cook for 12 minutes, then rest off the heat.

Put the chicken in a pan with the ginger, the spring onion lengths, the bashed garlic and 1 tsp of the salt. Cover with cold water, bring just to a simmer, then cover, turn off the heat and leave for 15 minutes until cooked through.
Meanwhile smack the cucumber with a rolling pin until it splits, tear it into bite-sized pieces and toss with the remaining salt and half the sugar. Leave in a colander for 10 minutes, then drain.
Crush the Sichuan peppercorns finely. Whisk the chilli oil, soy sauce, vinegar, remaining sugar, grated garlic and crushed peppercorns into a dressing.
Lift out the chicken, rest it for 3 minutes and shred or slice it. Toss with two-thirds of the dressing.
Serve the chicken over the rice with the cucumber, drizzled with the remaining dressing and scattered with the sesame seeds, sliced spring onion and coriander.

recipes.title: Salt and pepper tofu with peppers
recipes.blurb: Crisp-edged tofu tossed with garlic, chilli and peppers in a fragrant five-spice and pepper salt. Vegan.

ingredients.name: Firm tofu
ingredients.prep: pressed and cut into 2 cm cubes

steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 300 ml of water: boil, cover, turn right down and cook for 12 minutes, then rest off the heat.
Crush the Sichuan peppercorns and mix with the salt, black pepper and five-spice. Pat the tofu very dry and toss it in the cornflour until coated.
Heat 45 ml of the oil in a large frying pan or wok over a medium-high heat and fry the tofu in two batches for 6 minutes each, turning, until golden and crisp. Drain on kitchen paper.
Wipe out the pan, add the remaining oil and stir-fry the peppers for 3 minutes over a high heat.
Add the garlic, chilli and spring onion whites for 30 seconds, then return the tofu.
Sprinkle over the spice salt, toss for 1 minute and serve over the rice with the spring onion greens.

recipes.title: Black bean tofu with broccoli and peppers
recipes.blurb: Golden tofu, crisp broccoli and sweet pepper in a salty-savoury black bean sauce. Vegan and fast.
steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 300 ml of water: boil, cover, turn right down and cook for 12 minutes, then rest off the heat.
Toss the tofu with 2 g of the cornflour. Mix the black bean sauce, soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, sugar and 120 ml of water in a small bowl.
Heat half the oil in a wok over a high heat and fry the tofu for 5 minutes, turning, until golden. Lift it out.
Add the remaining oil and stir-fry the broccoli and red pepper for 3 minutes, splashing in 2 tbsp of water to steam them briefly.
Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds, then pour in the sauce and return the tofu.
Mix the rest of the cornflour with 1 tbsp of water, stir it in and bubble for 1 minute until glossy. Serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Egg foo yung-style omelettes with savoury gravy
recipes.blurb: Fluffy, golden omelettes packed with sprouts and mushrooms, under a glossy soy gravy, with rice.
steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 300 ml of water: boil, cover, turn right down and cook for 12 minutes, then rest off the heat.

For the gravy, crumble the stock cube into 150 ml of hot water and add the soy sauce, sugar and sesame oil. Mix the cornflour with 1 tbsp of cold water, stir it in, then simmer in a small pan for 2 minutes until glossy. Keep warm.
Beat the eggs with the salt and black pepper, then stir in the bean sprouts, mushrooms, peas and spring onion.
Heat 2 tbsp of the oil in a large non-stick frying pan over a medium-high heat. Spoon in half the mixture to make 2 or 3 small omelettes and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until golden underneath.
Flip and cook for 1 to 2 minutes more until set. Keep warm, then repeat with the remaining oil and mixture.
Serve the omelettes over the rice with the gravy poured over.

recipes.title: Ginger beef and broccoli stir-fry
recipes.blurb: Tender beef strips and crisp broccoli in a glossy ginger and oyster sauce, served over fluffy jasmine rice.
steps: Rinse the rice, then cook it in a lidded pan with 300 ml of water: bring to the boil, cover, turn the heat right down and cook for 12 minutes. Leave covered off the heat.
Toss the beef with the cornflour, half the soy sauce and the black pepper. In a small bowl, stir the oyster sauce with the rest of the soy and 60 ml of water.
Heat half the oil in a wok over a high heat. Fry the beef for 2 minutes until browned, then tip it onto a plate.
Add the remaining oil and stir-fry the broccoli with the spring onion whites for 3 minutes, adding a splash of water to steam it slightly.
Add the ginger and garlic for 30 seconds, then pour in the sauce and return the beef. Bubble for 1 minute until glossy.
Serve over the rice, scattered with the spring onion greens.

recipes.title: Sweet and sour chicken with peppers
recipes.blurb: Crisp-edged chicken, pineapple and peppers tossed in a bright, tangy sauce you can balance to taste.
steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 300 ml of water: boil, cover, reduce the heat to its lowest and cook for 12 minutes, then rest off the heat.
Stir the ketchup, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar and 4 tbsp of the pineapple juice or water together for the sauce.
Toss the chicken in 10 g of the cornflour and the salt. Fry it in half the oil over a medium-high heat for 6 to 7 minutes until golden and cooked through, then set aside.
Add the remaining oil and stir-fry the onion and peppers for 4 minutes so they keep some bite.
Return the chicken, add the pineapple and pour in the sauce. Mix the remaining cornflour with 1 tbsp of water, stir it in and bubble for 1 minute until thick and glossy.
Spoon over the rice and serve.

recipes.title: Fiery mapo-style tofu with mushrooms
recipes.blurb: Silky tofu and savoury mushrooms in a numbing-hot, chilli-oil sauce. Properly spicy and very vegan.
steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 300 ml of water: boil, cover, turn right down and cook for 12 minutes, then rest off the heat.
Cover the tofu cubes with boiling water and the salt and leave for 5 minutes to firm up, then drain gently.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok over a high heat. Fry the mushrooms for 5 minutes until deeply browned and dry.
Add the garlic, ginger, spring onion whites, chilli flakes and the chilli oil, stirring for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in the soy sauce, sugar, black pepper and 200 ml of water. Slide in the tofu and simmer for 4 minutes.
Mix the cornflour with 2 tbsp of cold water, stir it in and cook for 1 minute until the sauce clings. Serve over the rice with the spring onion greens.

recipes.title: Egg fried rice with peas and spring onion
recipes.blurb: Fast, satisfying fried rice with soft scrambled egg, sweet peas and toasted sesame oil.
steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 300 ml of water: boil, cover, reduce to the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then spread it on a tray to cool and dry for 5 minutes.
Beat the eggs with the salt. Heat half the vegetable oil in a wok over a high heat and scramble the eggs for 30 seconds until just set, then tip them out.
Add the remaining oil and stir-fry the carrot and spring onion whites for 2 minutes.
Add the garlic and rice, pressing it against the hot wok and tossing for 3 minutes until it begins to crisp.
Stir in the peas, soy sauce and pepper and cook for 2 minutes. Fold the egg back in.
Finish with the sesame oil and the spring onion greens.

recipes.title: Hoisin pork and pak choi noodles
recipes.blurb: Sticky hoisin pork strips with wilted pak choi and slippery egg noodles, a gentle-heat midweek favourite.
steps: Cook the noodles in boiling water to the packet time, drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk the hoisin, soy sauce, rice vinegar and 3 tbsp of water in a small bowl.
Heat half the oil in a wok over a high heat and fry the pork for 3 to 4 minutes until browned at the edges, then remove.
Add the remaining oil and stir-fry the carrot and pak choi stems for 2 minutes, then add the ginger, garlic and half the chilli for 30 seconds.
Return the pork with the noodles, pak choi leaves and sauce. Toss for 2 minutes until everything is hot and coated.
Serve topped with the remaining chilli.

recipes.title: Chicken katsu curry with rice
recipes.blurb: Crunchy panko chicken with a mild, sweet Japanese-style curry sauce and a quick cucumber pickle.

ingredients.name: Chicken breast
ingredients.prep: sliced in half horizontally to make 2 thin cutlets

steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 300 ml of water: boil, cover, reduce to the lowest heat for 12 minutes and rest off the heat. Toss the cucumber with the rice vinegar and a pinch of salt.
Soften the onion and carrot in 1 tbsp of the oil for 8 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger, 20 g of the flour and the curry powder and stir for 1 minute.
Crumble in the stock cube, add 350 ml of water, the soy sauce and the sugar. Simmer for 12 minutes, then blend with a stick blender until smooth, or leave chunky if you prefer.
Season the chicken with salt. Coat each piece in the remaining flour, then egg, then panko, pressing the crumbs on.
Heat the remaining oil in a frying pan over a medium heat and fry the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until deep golden and cooked through. Drain on kitchen paper.
Slice the chicken and serve over the rice with the curry sauce and cucumber pickle.

recipes.title: Teriyaki salmon and edamame rice bowl
recipes.blurb: Glazed salmon over sticky rice with edamame and crunchy cucumber. Ready in just over twenty minutes.
steps: Cook the rice in a lidded pan with 300 ml of water: boil, cover, reduce to the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then rest off the heat. Cook the edamame in boiling water for 3 minutes and drain.
Stir the soy sauce, mirin, sugar and ginger together until the sugar dissolves.
Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the salmon for 3 minutes on one side until golden.
Turn the fillets, pour in the teriyaki mixture and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, spooning it over until sticky and the fish is just cooked.
Divide the rice between bowls and add the edamame and cucumber. Flake or slice the salmon on top, drizzle with the pan glaze and scatter over the spring onion and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Miso-glazed aubergine rice bowl
recipes.blurb: Sweet-salty miso aubergine roasted until soft and caramelised, with rice, cucumber and sesame.

ingredients.name: Aubergine
ingredients.prep: halved lengthways, flesh scored in a criss-cross

steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Brush the cut sides of the aubergine with 2 tbsp of the oil and roast cut-side down on a tray for 20 minutes until soft.
