Pour in the passata and 100 ml of water with the remaining salt, add the meatballs back, cover and simmer for 12 minutes until cooked through and the sauce is thick.
Meanwhile, pour 150 ml of boiling water over the couscous with a pinch of salt, cover for 5 minutes, then fluff.
Stir the mint and a squeeze of lemon into the yoghurt. Serve the meatballs over the couscous with the yoghurt alongside to temper the heat.

recipes.title: Ras el hanout cauliflower traybake with herby couscous
recipes.blurb: Whole-roasted cauliflower florets in warm North African spices with chickpeas and lemon couscous.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the cauliflower, chickpeas and red onion on a large tray with 30 ml of the oil, the ras el hanout, garlic, salt and pepper.
Roast for 30 minutes, turning once, until the cauliflower is deeply golden and the chickpeas are crisp at the edges.
Meanwhile, pour 150 ml of boiling water mixed with the stock cube over the couscous, cover and leave for 5 minutes.
Fluff the couscous and stir through the lemon zest, a squeeze of juice, the remaining oil, parsley, mint and cucumber.
Scatter the pumpkin seeds over the traybake for the last 3 minutes to toast, then serve on the couscous.

recipes.title: Sausage and fennel penne
recipes.blurb: Crumbled pork sausage and sweet fennel simmered in tomato, tossed through penne with a little chilli.
steps: Heat the oil in a large deep pan over a medium-high heat. Squeeze the sausage meat out of its skins in small nuggets and fry for 6-7 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Add the onion and fennel with a pinch of salt and cook for 8 minutes until soft and lightly golden, then stir in the garlic and chilli flakes for 30 seconds.
Pour in the chopped tomatoes with half a tin of water, season and simmer for 12 minutes until the sauce is thick and glossy.
Meanwhile, cook the penne in well-salted boiling water for 10-11 minutes until just tender. Save a mugful of the cooking water, then drain.
Tip the pasta into the sauce with a splash of the cooking water and toss over the heat for a minute.
Serve topped with the parmesan, parsley and black pepper.

recipes.title: Beef and mushroom ragu rigatoni
recipes.blurb: A slow-feeling beef ragu with red wine, chestnut mushrooms and carrot, spooned over big tubes of rigatoni.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan over a high heat and brown the mince for 5-6 minutes, breaking it up well. Tip it into a bowl, leaving a spoonful of fat behind.
Lower the heat to medium and cook the onion, carrot and mushrooms for 8-10 minutes until the mushroom moisture has cooked away and everything is soft.
Stir in the garlic, tomato puree and oregano for a minute, then pour in the red wine and let it bubble for 3 minutes until reduced by half. Return the beef to the pan.
Add the chopped tomatoes and the stock cube crumbled into 100 ml of hot water. Season, then simmer gently for 20 minutes until rich and thick.
Boil the rigatoni in well-salted water for 11-12 minutes until tender, saving a splash of cooking water before draining.
Toss the pasta through the ragu, loosening with the reserved water, and serve with the parmesan and plenty of black pepper.

recipes.title: Mushroom, spinach and parmesan risotto
recipes.blurb: Creamy risotto with browned chestnut mushrooms, wilted spinach, thyme and a bright squeeze of lemon.
steps: Dissolve the stock cubes in 750 ml of boiling water and keep it hot in a pan on a low heat.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over a high heat and fry the mushrooms for 6-7 minutes without crowding until deep golden. Season, then scoop them out onto a plate.

Lower the heat, add half the butter and the onion, and cook for 5 minutes until soft. Add the garlic, thyme and rice and stir for 1 minute until the grains turn glossy, then pour in the white wine and stir until it has almost all been absorbed.
Add the hot stock a ladleful at a time, stirring often and letting each addition mostly absorb before the next. This takes about 18-20 minutes, and the rice should be creamy with a little bite.
Fold in the spinach, mushrooms, remaining butter and most of the parmesan. Add a squeeze of lemon juice and a little zest, then rest the pan off the heat for 2 minutes.
Serve in warm bowls with the last of the parmesan and black pepper.

recipes.title: Tomato and mozzarella gnocchi bake
recipes.blurb: Pillowy gnocchi baked in a basil tomato sauce with blistered cherry tomatoes and bubbling mozzarella.
steps: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan) and put a kettle on.
In a medium ovenproof dish, stir together the chopped tomatoes, garlic, oregano, oil, salt, pepper and a splash of water.
Add the gnocchi straight from the packet and the halved cherry tomatoes, turning everything to coat, then bake for 12 minutes.
Stir in the spinach so it wilts into the sauce, scatter over the mozzarella and parmesan, and return to the oven for 8-10 minutes until bubbling and golden in patches.
Rest for 2 minutes, then top with torn basil.

recipes.title: Vegan penne arrabbiata with olives
recipes.blurb: A properly fiery tomato and garlic sauce with fresh chilli and briny olives, no cheese needed.
steps: Boil the penne in well-salted water for 10-11 minutes until just tender. Save a mugful of the cooking water, then drain.
While the pasta cooks, warm the oil in a deep frying pan over a medium heat and add the garlic, fresh chilli and chilli flakes. Cook for 1 minute, stirring, until fragrant but not browned.
Pour in the chopped tomatoes, add the sugar and a good pinch of salt, and simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Stir in the olives, then add the pasta with a splash of the cooking water and toss over the heat for 1 minute.
Finish with torn basil and black pepper.

recipes.title: Chilli prawn and cherry tomato linguine
recipes.blurb: Juicy king prawns, burst cherry tomatoes, lemon and a gentle chilli kick through silky linguine.
steps: Cook the linguine in well-salted boiling water for 9-10 minutes until al dente. Save a mugful of cooking water, then drain.
Meanwhile, heat half the oil in a large frying pan over a high heat. Season the prawns and cook for 1-2 minutes per side until pink, then lift them out.
Lower the heat, add the remaining oil, garlic and chilli for 30 seconds, then add the cherry tomatoes with a pinch of salt. Cook for 4-5 minutes, pressing them until they burst.
Add the linguine, a splash of cooking water, the zest of the lemon and a good squeeze of its juice. Toss until the sauce clings.
Return the prawns to the pan, stir through the parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken, olive and pepper rosemary traybake
recipes.blurb: Chicken thighs roasted over baby potatoes, sweet peppers and olives with rosemary and lemon.

ingredients.name: Garlic clove
ingredients.prep: left in their skins, lightly crushed

steps: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Toss the potatoes with half the oil, half the rosemary and a pinch of salt on a large tray and roast for 15 minutes.
Toss the chicken in the remaining oil and rosemary, with salt and pepper, and cut the lemon in half.
Add the chicken, pepper, red onion, garlic and the lemon halves cut-side down to the tray, turning everything together, and roast for 15 minutes.
Add the olives and cherry tomatoes and roast for 8-10 minutes more, until the chicken is cooked through with no pink and the tomatoes have softened.
Squeeze the roasted lemon over the tray and serve from the tray.

recipes.title: Salmon, caper and lemon linguine
recipes.blurb: Flaked pan-fried salmon and spinach in a light lemony creme fraiche sauce with salty capers.
steps: Cook the linguine in well-salted boiling water for 9-10 minutes until al dente. Save a mugful of the cooking water, then drain.
Meanwhile, season the salmon and fry skin-side down in the oil in a large non-stick pan over a medium-high heat for 4 minutes. Turn and cook for 2-3 minutes more until just cooked through.
Lift the salmon out and flake it into large pieces, discarding the skin if you like. Add the garlic and capers to the pan for 30 seconds.
Stir in the creme fraiche, the lemon zest and juice, and a splash of pasta water, then add the spinach until it just wilts.
Toss in the linguine and flaked salmon gently so it holds its shape, then top with parsley and black pepper.

recipes.title: Tuscan white bean and kale stew
recipes.blurb: Cannellini beans, kale and rosemary in a thick tomato broth, served with olive oil toast.
steps: Heat 15 ml of the oil in a large pan over a medium heat. Cook the onion, carrot and celery with a pinch of salt for 8-10 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic and rosemary and cook for 1 minute, then pour in the chopped tomatoes and the stock cube dissolved in 400 ml of hot water.
Tip in the cannellini beans, bring to a simmer and cook for 15 minutes. Crush a handful of beans against the side of the pan to thicken the stew.
Stir in the kale and cook for 5 minutes until tender. Season with salt and plenty of pepper.
Toast the sourdough, drizzle with the remaining oil and serve alongside the stew.

recipes.title: Lemon ricotta and courgette spaghetti
recipes.blurb: Golden courgette ribbons and creamy lemon ricotta tossed through spaghetti with basil and toasted pine nuts.
steps: Toast the pine nuts in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 2-3 minutes until golden, then tip them out.
Cook the spaghetti in well-salted boiling water for 10 minutes until al dente. Save a mugful of cooking water, then drain.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in the pan over a high heat and fry the courgette with a pinch of salt for 6-7 minutes until golden at the edges. Add the garlic for the last 30 seconds.
Mix the ricotta with the lemon zest, a squeeze of juice, the parmesan and a splash of the pasta water until loose and creamy.
Toss the spaghetti and courgette with the ricotta mixture off the heat, loosening with more water if needed. Top with basil, pine nuts and black pepper.

recipes.title: Aubergine and mozzarella tomato bake
recipes.blurb: Roasted aubergine layered with garlicky tomato sauce, melting mozzarella and parmesan, with a peppery side salad.
steps: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Toss the aubergine rounds with 25 ml of the oil and half the salt on two trays, then roast for 20 minutes, turning once, until golden and soft.
Meanwhile, soften the onion in 10 ml oil in a pan for 6 minutes, add the garlic and oregano for 30 seconds, then pour in the passata. Simmer for 10 minutes and season.
Spoon a little sauce into a baking dish, then layer in aubergine, sauce and half the basil, repeating until everything is used.
Top with the mozzarella and parmesan and bake for 12-15 minutes until bubbling and browned.
Dress the leaves with the balsamic and remaining oil, and serve alongside the bake with the last of the basil.

recipes.title: Lemon fennel pork steaks with crushed potatoes
recipes.blurb: Pan-seared pork loin steaks with roasted fennel, thyme and lemony crushed baby potatoes.
steps: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Boil the potatoes in salted water for 12 minutes until tender, then drain.
Toss the fennel wedges with half the oil, the thyme and a pinch of salt on a tray and roast for 10 minutes.
Tip the potatoes onto the tray, crush each one lightly with the back of a spoon, drizzle with a little more oil and roast for a further 12-15 minutes.
Rub the pork with the mustard, salt and pepper. Fry in the remaining oil in a hot pan for 3-4 minutes per side until cooked through, adding the garlic for the last minute.
Rest the pork for 3 minutes, then squeeze over a little lemon juice and zest. Stir the parsley into the potatoes and serve everything together.

recipes.title: Greek lemon chicken orzo
recipes.blurb: Chicken and orzo cooked in one pan in a lemony, oregano-scented broth, finished with spinach and feta.
steps: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over a medium-high heat. Season the chicken and brown for 5 minutes, then lift it out onto a plate.
Add the onion to the pan and cook for 5 minutes until soft, then add the garlic and oregano for 30 seconds.
Stir in the orzo to coat it in the oil, then add the stock cube dissolved in 500 ml of boiling water and the zest and juice of the lemon.
Return the chicken, bring to a simmer and cook for 12-14 minutes, stirring now and then, until the orzo is tender and the sauce is creamy.
Fold in the spinach until wilted, then top with the feta, parsley and black pepper.

recipes.title: Lamb kofta pittas with tzatziki
recipes.blurb: Herby cumin-scented lamb patties tucked into warm pittas with tomato, red onion and cool cucumber yoghurt.

ingredients.name: Cucumber
ingredients.prep: half grated and squeezed dry, half sliced

steps: Mix the lamb with the grated red onion, garlic, cumin, oregano, parsley, half the mint, half the salt and the pepper. Shape into 8 small oval patties.
Stir the grated cucumber, remaining mint, the rest of the salt and a squeeze of lemon into the yoghurt to make a quick tzatziki.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat and cook the kofta for 3-4 minutes per side until browned and cooked through.
Warm the pittas in a toaster or dry pan for 30 seconds on each side.
Stuff the pittas with the kofta, tomato, sliced red onion and sliced cucumber, and finish with plenty of tzatziki and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.title: Prawn and feta tomato bake
recipes.blurb: King prawns baked in a garlicky oregano tomato sauce under crumbled feta, with ciabatta for mopping.
steps: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Warm the oil in an ovenproof frying pan over a medium heat and cook the onion for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, oregano and chilli flakes for 30 seconds, then pour in the chopped tomatoes. Season and simmer for 8 minutes until thick.
Stir the prawns into the sauce, scatter the feta over the top and bake for 8-10 minutes until the prawns are pink and the feta is lightly golden.
Warm the ciabatta in the oven for the final 3 minutes.
Scatter with parsley and serve straight from the pan with the ciabatta for mopping.

recipes.title: Grilled halloumi Greek salad with pittas
recipes.blurb: Golden halloumi slices over crunchy tomato, cucumber, olive and little gem salad with warm oregano pitta.
steps: Soak the sliced red onion in the vinegar with a pinch of salt for 10 minutes to soften its bite.
Combine the tomatoes, cucumber, little gem and olives in a large bowl and tip in the onion with its vinegar. Dress with 15 ml of the oil, a squeeze of lemon and the pepper.
Heat a dry non-stick frying pan over a medium-high heat and cook the halloumi for 1-2 minutes per side until deeply golden.
Rub the pittas with the remaining oil and the oregano, then toast them for about 30 seconds on each side in the same pan or a toaster.
Pile the halloumi over the salad and serve with the warm pittas.

recipes.title: Greek butter bean and tomato bake
recipes.blurb: Big butter beans slow-baked in sweet oregano tomato sauce with spinach, finished with parsley and crusty toast.
steps: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Warm 15 ml of the oil in an ovenproof pan over a medium heat and cook the onion for 8 minutes until soft and sweet.
Add the garlic, oregano and tomato puree and cook for 1 minute, then add the chopped tomatoes, sugar, salt and pepper with 100 ml of water.
Stir in the butter beans and spinach, bring to a simmer, then bake for 20 minutes until the sauce is thick and the beans are jammy.
Toast the sourdough and drizzle with the remaining oil.
Top the beans with parsley and serve with the toast.

recipes.title: Spinach and feta puff pastry pie
recipes.blurb: A folded golden pastry parcel of wilted spinach, tangy feta, spring onion and dill with a crisp leafy side.
steps: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Warm half the oil in a large pan, add the spring onions for 1 minute, then add the spinach in handfuls until wilted, about 3 minutes.
Tip the spinach into a sieve and press out as much water as you can, then chop it roughly into a bowl.
Beat 1 egg and stir half of it into the spinach with the feta, dill, lemon zest, salt and pepper.
Unroll the pastry on its paper onto a baking tray. Spread the filling over one half, leaving a 2 cm edge, then fold the other half over and press the edges with a fork to seal.
Beat the remaining eggs with the reserved beaten egg and brush all over the pastry, cut two slits in the top, then bake for 22-25 minutes until puffed and deep golden.
Dress the leaves with the remaining oil and a squeeze of lemon, and serve with slices of the pie.

recipes.title: Chorizo and butter bean stew
recipes.blurb: Smoky chorizo, red pepper and butter beans in a paprika tomato sauce, finished with spinach and toasted sourdough.
steps: Fry the chorizo in a large pan over a medium heat for 4-5 minutes until it releases its red oil and the edges crisp. Lift out half and set aside for topping.
Add the onion and pepper to the pan and cook for 8 minutes until soft, then stir in the garlic and smoked paprika for 1 minute.
Pour in the chopped tomatoes and 100 ml of water, add the beans, and simmer for 12-15 minutes until thick. Mash a few beans into the sauce to give it body.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts and season with salt and pepper.
Toast the sourdough with the oil, then serve the stew topped with the reserved chorizo, the parsley and the toast.

recipes.title: Garlic chilli prawns with smoky tomatoes
recipes.blurb: Sizzling garlic and chilli prawns with blistered tomatoes, smoked paprika and a baguette for the oil.
steps: Warm the baguette slices in the oven at 180C (160C fan) for 5 minutes while you cook.
Heat 15 ml of the oil in a frying pan over a high heat and cook the cherry tomatoes with a pinch of salt for 3-4 minutes until blistered, then tip them into a bowl.
Lower the heat to medium, add the remaining oil, the garlic, fresh chilli and chilli flakes and sizzle for 1 minute until fragrant but not brown.
Add the prawns and smoked paprika and cook for 2-3 minutes, turning once, until pink and curled.
Return the tomatoes to the pan with a squeeze of lemon and the parsley, and toss.
Serve with the rocket and the warm baguette to mop up the garlicky oil.

recipes.title: Smoky chickpeas and spinach on toast
recipes.blurb: Garlicky smoked-paprika chickpeas wilted with spinach and tomatoes, piled onto olive oil sourdough.
steps: Heat 15 ml of the oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat and cook the onion with a pinch of salt for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, smoked paprika, cumin and chilli flakes and stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chickpeas and cherry tomatoes with 100 ml of water and cook for 8 minutes, pressing a few chickpeas and tomatoes with a spoon until the sauce thickens.
Stir in the spinach and vinegar and cook for 2 minutes until wilted. Taste and season.
Toast the sourdough and drizzle with the remaining oil, then pile the chickpeas on top.

recipes.title: Patatas bravas with fried eggs and garlic yoghurt
recipes.blurb: Crisp roasted potatoes under spicy smoky tomato sauce, topped with runny eggs, garlic yoghurt and wilted spinach.
steps: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Toss the potatoes with 25 ml of the oil and half the salt on a large tray and roast for 30-35 minutes, turning twice, until crisp and golden.

Meanwhile, warm 10 ml oil in a pan, add 2 of the garlic cloves, the smoked paprika and chilli flakes for 30 seconds, then add the chopped tomatoes, vinegar and a pinch of salt. Simmer for 15 minutes until thick, then blend or mash until fairly smooth.
Stir the remaining garlic into the yoghurt with a squeeze of lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Wilt the spinach in a hot dry pan for 1-2 minutes, then set aside.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil over a medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes until the whites are set and the edges are crisp.
Pile the potatoes onto plates with the spinach, spoon over the bravas sauce, top with an egg and a dollop of garlic yoghurt, and finish with parsley.

recipes.title: Chicken and chorizo smoky rice
recipes.blurb: A paella-style one-pan rice with chicken thighs, chorizo, red pepper and peas, scented with smoked paprika.
steps: Heat the oil in a wide, deep pan over a medium-high heat. Season the chicken and brown it with the chorizo for 6-7 minutes until the chorizo has released its oil.
Add the onion and red pepper and cook for 6 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic, smoked paprika, turmeric and tomato puree for 1 minute.
Stir in the rice to coat it, then pour in the stock cube dissolved in 450 ml of boiling water. Bring to a simmer, then do not stir again.
Cook gently, uncovered, for 15 minutes until most of the liquid has absorbed, scattering the peas over in the last 3 minutes.
Take off the heat, cover with a lid or foil and rest for 5 minutes. Serve with the parsley and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Vegetable paella with peppers and green beans
recipes.blurb: Saffron-hued smoky rice with red pepper, courgette, green beans and peas, finished with lemon and parsley.
steps: Dissolve the stock cubes in 500 ml of boiling water and keep it hot.
Heat the oil in a wide, deep pan over a medium heat and cook the onion, pepper and courgette for 8 minutes until softened and lightly golden.
Stir in the garlic, smoked paprika, turmeric and tomato puree for 1 minute, then add the rice and stir until coated.
Pour in the hot stock, add the green beans, season and bring to a simmer. Cook uncovered for 15 minutes without stirring, until the rice is nearly tender.
Scatter the peas over the top and cook for 3 minutes more, then rest off the heat, covered, for 5 minutes.
Serve with the parsley and wedges of lemon to squeeze over.

recipes.title: Chicken shawarma-style traybake with garlic yoghurt
recipes.blurb: Thighs, crisp potatoes and peppers roasted in warm allspice and cumin, with a lemony garlic yoghurt to spoon over.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Tip the potatoes onto a large tray with half the oil and a pinch of salt and roast for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, mix the chicken with the crushed garlic, cumin, paprika, allspice, cinnamon, turmeric, the juice of half the lemon, the rest of the oil, the remaining salt and the black pepper.
Take the tray out, push the potatoes to one side and add the chicken, red pepper and onion. Roast for 20–25 minutes, turning once, until the chicken is cooked through and the edges are charred.
Stir the grated garlic into the yoghurt with a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt.
Pile the traybake onto plates, spoon over the garlic yoghurt, scatter with parsley and serve with the remaining lemon cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Kafta with buttery rice, lemon tahini and sumac onions
recipes.blurb: Herby, allspice-scented beef fingers over fluffy rice with a nutty tahini sauce and tangy pink onions.
steps: Squeeze the grated onion in your hands to remove the juice, then mix it with the beef mince, half the parsley, the allspice, cinnamon, paprika, 2 teaspoons of salt and the black pepper. Shape into 8 short fingers.
Toss the sliced red onion with the sumac, the juice of half the lemon and a pinch of salt and leave to soften.
Rinse the rice, then cook it in plenty of boiling salted water for 10–12 minutes. Drain and let it steam dry for 2 minutes.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat and fry the kafta for 8–10 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through.
Whisk the tahini with the garlic, the rest of the lemon juice, a pinch of salt and 50 ml cold water until pourable and pale.
Serve the kafta on the rice with the tomatoes and sumac onions, drizzle with the tahini and finish with the remaining parsley.

recipes.title: Mujadara with crispy onions and lemon tahini
recipes.blurb: Spiced Puy lentils and rice under a heap of deep-brown onions, with a crunchy tomato salad and tahini.
steps: Heat 45 ml of the oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat, add the onions with a pinch of salt and cook for 20–25 minutes, stirring often, until deep brown and crisp at the edges. Lift half out onto a plate.
Meanwhile, put the lentils in a saucepan with the stock cube, cumin, allspice, cinnamon and 600 ml water. Bring to the boil and simmer for 12 minutes.
Rinse the rice and stir it into the lentils with the remaining salt. Cover and cook on a low heat for 12–15 minutes until both are tender and the water is absorbed. Rest, covered, for 5 minutes.
Toss the cucumber, tomatoes and parsley with the remaining oil, half the lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Whisk the tahini with the rest of the lemon juice, black pepper and 40 ml cold water.
Stir the onions from the pan through the lentils and rice, top with the reserved crispy onions and serve with the salad and tahini.

recipes.title: Maghmour-style baked aubergine and chickpeas
recipes.blurb: Silky roast aubergine and chickpeas in a garlicky tomato sauce with a tang of pomegranate molasses.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the aubergine with 30 ml of the oil and a teaspoon of salt on a large tray and roast for 25 minutes, turning once, until soft and golden.
Meanwhile, heat the remaining oil in a large ovenproof pan over a medium heat and soften the onion for 6–8 minutes. Add the garlic, cumin, cinnamon and chilli flakes and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas, pomegranate molasses, the remaining salt and the black pepper and simmer for 8 minutes until thickened.
Fold the roasted aubergine through the sauce and bake for 10 minutes. Warm the pitta in the oven for the last 2 minutes.
Scatter with parsley and serve with the warm pitta for scooping.

recipes.title: Shish taouk-style chicken skewers with garlic yoghurt
recipes.blurb: Yoghurt-marinated chicken with lemon, garlic and paprika, charred on skewers and tucked into warm pitta.
steps: Mix 100 g of the yoghurt with two-thirds of the garlic, the tomato puree, paprika, allspice, the zest of the lemon, the oil, 2 teaspoons of salt and the black pepper. Stir in the chicken and leave for 10 minutes, or longer if you have time.
Heat the grill to high. Thread the chicken onto skewers, alternating with the red pepper and onion chunks.
Grill the skewers for 12–14 minutes, turning every few minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and charred in places.
Stir the rest of the garlic, a squeeze of lemon juice and a pinch of salt into the remaining yoghurt.
Warm the pitta under the grill for 30 seconds each side. Serve the skewers in the pitta with the cucumber, mint and garlic yoghurt, with the rest of the lemon cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Batata harra potatoes with fried eggs
recipes.blurb: Crisp fried potatoes tossed in garlic, chilli, lemon and fresh coriander, topped with runny eggs.
steps: Boil the potatoes in well-salted water for 7–8 minutes until just tender at the edges, then drain and let them steam dry for 3 minutes.
Heat 30 ml of the oil in a large non-stick frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the potatoes for 12–15 minutes, turning only now and then, until crisp and golden all over.

Add the garlic, chilli, ground coriander and chilli flakes and fry for 1 minute, shaking the pan, until fragrant. Take off the heat and toss with half the coriander, the juice of half the lemon and the black pepper.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil in a second pan over a medium-high heat for 2–3 minutes until the whites are set and crisp at the edges.
Divide the potatoes between plates, top with the tomatoes and eggs, and finish with the rest of the coriander and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.title: Lamb and rice stuffed red peppers with minted yoghurt
recipes.blurb: Sweet roast peppers filled with allspice-spiced lamb, rice and toasted pine nuts in a tomato bath.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Boil the rice in salted water for 6 minutes, then drain.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat, add the onion and cook for 5 minutes. Add the lamb mince, garlic, allspice and cinnamon and fry for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Stir in the tomato puree, the drained rice, the pine nuts, half the parsley, 2 teaspoons of salt and the black pepper.
Stand the pepper halves in a snug baking dish and spoon the filling into them. Mix the passata with 100 ml water and a pinch of salt and pour it around the peppers.
Cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes, then uncover and bake for 10 minutes more until the peppers are soft and the tops are lightly browned.
Stir the mint into the yoghurt and serve with the peppers, spooning over some of the sauce and the rest of the parsley.

recipes.title: Fatteh-style chickpeas with garlic yoghurt and crisp pitta
recipes.blurb: Warm spiced chickpeas over crunchy pitta, drowned in tahini yoghurt and finished with sizzling pine nuts.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Toss the pitta with 10 ml of the oil and a pinch of salt on a tray and bake for 8 minutes until golden and crisp.
Whisk the yoghurt with the tahini, garlic, the juice of half the lemon and a good pinch of salt until smooth.

Heat 10 ml of the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat, add the chickpeas, cumin, paprika and black pepper and cook for 5–6 minutes, stirring, until hot and lightly crisped. Squeeze in a little lemon juice.
Wipe the pan, add the last of the oil and the pine nuts and toast for 1–2 minutes until golden.
Layer the pitta in bowls, spoon over the chickpeas, then the yoghurt, and finish with the pine nuts and their oil, the parsley and the remaining lemon cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Seven-spice chicken and bulgur pilaf with almonds
recipes.blurb: Chicken and nutty bulgur cooked together in a warm Lebanese-style spice blend, finished with toasted almonds.
steps: Mix the allspice, cinnamon, cumin, paprika, ground coriander and black pepper in a small bowl. This is your seven-spice-style blend.
Heat 15 ml of the oil in a deep frying pan with a lid over a medium-high heat and brown the chicken for 5 minutes. Lift out onto a plate.
Add the remaining oil and the onion to the pan and cook for 5 minutes, then stir in the garlic, the spice mix and the tomato puree and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the bulgur, crumble in the stock cube and add 350 ml boiling water and the salt. Return the chicken, cover and simmer very gently for 12 minutes until the water is absorbed.
Toast the almonds in a dry pan for 2 minutes. Rest the pilaf off the heat for 5 minutes, fluff with a fork and serve topped with the almonds and parsley, with the yoghurt on the side.

recipes.title: Lebanese-style lentil and spinach soup with lemon
recipes.blurb: A comforting red lentil soup with wilted spinach, cumin and a sharp squeeze of lemon.
steps: Heat 20 ml of the oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Cook the onion and carrot with a pinch of salt for 8 minutes until softened.
Stir in the garlic, cumin and ground coriander and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, crumble in the stock cubes and pour in 900 ml boiling water. Simmer for 15–18 minutes until the lentils have broken down.
Stir in the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted. Blend roughly with a stick blender if you like a smoother soup.
Season with the juice of the lemon, the remaining salt and the black pepper, and serve with the last of the oil and the coriander on top.

recipes.title: Samke harra-style fish with tahini and chilli coriander
recipes.blurb: Roast white fish with cumin, spooned with lemony tahini and a fiery garlic and coriander relish, over rice.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Rub the fish with the cumin, half the oil, a teaspoon of salt and the black pepper, lay it on a lined tray and bake for 10–12 minutes until it flakes easily.
Meanwhile, rinse the rice and cook it in plenty of boiling salted water for 10–12 minutes, then drain.
Crush 2 cloves of garlic with a pinch of salt and mix with the chilli, coriander, the juice of ½ lemon and the remaining oil to make a relish.
Whisk the tahini with the last clove of garlic, the juice of the other lemon half, a pinch of salt and 50 ml cold water until smooth and pourable.
Toast the pine nuts in a dry pan for 2 minutes until golden.
Serve the fish over the rice with the tahini sauce, the chilli relish and the pine nuts, with the second lemon cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Persian-style herb kuku with walnuts and yoghurt
recipes.blurb: A thick, bright-green herb frittata studded with walnuts, baked until set and served with cool yoghurt.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Brush a 20 cm ovenproof frying pan with half the oil.
Whisk the eggs with the turmeric, flour, baking powder, 2 teaspoons of salt and the black pepper until smooth.
Stir in the parsley, coriander, dill, spring onions, spinach and walnuts so the mixture is more herb than egg.
Heat the pan over a medium heat, pour in the mixture and cook for 3 minutes until the base starts to set, then transfer to the oven for 20–25 minutes until firm in the centre and golden.
Warm the pitta in the oven for the last 2 minutes. Season the yoghurt with a pinch of salt and the remaining oil.
Turn the kuku out, cut into wedges and serve with the yoghurt, cucumber and warm pitta.

recipes.title: Iraqi-style tomato and white bean stew with rice
recipes.blurb: Soft cannellini beans simmered in a baharat-scented tomato sauce with lemon, spooned over fluffy rice.
steps: Heat the oil in a wide pan over a medium heat and cook the onion with a pinch of salt for 7–8 minutes until soft and golden.
Add the garlic, tomato puree, cumin, cinnamon, allspice and paprika and cook, stirring, for 1–2 minutes.
Stir in the tomatoes, the beans, 150 ml water, 2 teaspoons of salt and the black pepper. Simmer for 15–18 minutes, stirring now and then, until the sauce is thick and the beans are creamy.
Meanwhile, rinse the rice and cook it in plenty of boiling salted water for 10–12 minutes, then drain.
Finish the stew with the juice of half the lemon, spoon it over the rice and scatter with parsley, with the rest of the lemon cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Turkish-style lamb pide with peppers and egg
recipes.blurb: Boat-shaped yoghurt flatbreads piled with spiced lamb and peppers, baked hot with a runny egg in the middle.
steps: Heat the oven to 240°C (220°C fan) with a large tray inside. Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium-high heat and fry the lamb mince for 5 minutes until browned.
Add the onion, red pepper, garlic, tomato puree, paprika, cumin, chilli flakes, a teaspoon of salt and the black pepper and cook for 6–8 minutes until dry and fragrant. Cool for a few minutes.

Mix the flour, baking powder and 2 teaspoons of salt with 180 g of the yoghurt to a soft dough, then knead briefly on a floured surface. Divide into 2 equal pieces and roll each piece into a long oval about 30 cm long.
Pinch the long edges up and in to make a boat shape with a rim, then spoon the lamb mixture into the middle, leaving the rim clear.
Slide the pides onto the hot tray and bake for 10 minutes. Make a well in each filling, crack in an egg, and bake for 3–4 minutes more until the egg is just set.
Scatter with parsley, squeeze over some lemon and serve with the remaining yoghurt on the side.

recipes.title: Syrian-style lentil kibbeh bowls with pomegranate
recipes.blurb: Spiced red lentil and bulgur patties, crisp outside and tender within, in a fresh salad bowl with tahini.
steps: Simmer the lentils in 300 ml water with a pinch of salt for 10–12 minutes until soft and the water has been absorbed. Stir in the bulgur, cover and leave off the heat for 15 minutes.

Meanwhile, heat 20 ml of the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat and cook the onions for 8–10 minutes until golden. Stir in the allspice, cinnamon, cumin, paprika and tomato puree and cook for 1 minute.
Mix the onions into the lentil mixture with the flour, walnuts, 2 teaspoons of salt and the black pepper. Let it cool for 5 minutes, then shape into 8 small patties with damp hands.
Wipe out the pan, heat 25 ml of the oil over a medium-high heat and fry the patties for 3–4 minutes on each side until crisp and golden.
Whisk the tahini with half the lemon juice, a pinch of salt and 40 ml cold water. Toss the cucumber, tomato, leaves and parsley with the pomegranate molasses and the rest of the lemon juice.
Divide the salad between bowls, top with the patties and drizzle with the tahini.

recipes.title: Chicken, lemon and olive tagine with couscous
recipes.blurb: Tender chicken simmered with ginger, turmeric, soft lemon and green olives, piled over herby couscous.
steps: Season the chicken with a teaspoon of salt and the black pepper. Heat 15 ml of the oil in a wide casserole or deep pan over a medium-high heat and brown the chicken for 5 minutes. Lift out onto a plate.
Add the remaining oil and the onion and cook for 6 minutes. Stir in the garlic, ginger, cumin, turmeric and cinnamon and cook for 1 minute.
Cut 1 lemon into thin slices, discarding the pips. Return the chicken to the pan with the lemon slices, the olives, the stock cube and 300 ml boiling water.
Cover and simmer gently for 20 minutes, then uncover and cook for 5 minutes more to thicken the sauce.
Put the couscous in a bowl with a pinch of salt and the juice of the second lemon, pour over 200 ml boiling water, cover for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.
Stir half the coriander through the couscous, spoon the tagine over and scatter with the rest.

recipes.title: Moroccan harira-style soup with chickpeas and lentils
recipes.blurb: A warming tomato soup with lentils, chickpeas, cinnamon and ginger, finished with lemon and a lot of fresh herbs.
steps: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat and cook the onion, celery and carrot with a pinch of salt for 8 minutes until softened.
Stir in the garlic, tomato puree, turmeric, ginger, cinnamon and cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, lentils, chickpeas, stock cubes and 800 ml boiling water. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the orzo and simmer for 8–10 minutes until tender, adding a splash of water if the soup gets too thick.
Add half the coriander and parsley, the juice of half the lemon, the remaining salt and the black pepper, and serve topped with the rest of the herbs and the remaining lemon cut into wedges.

recipes.title: BLT sandwich with avocado
recipes.blurb: Crisp bacon, juicy tomato and cool avocado piled into toasted bread with a slick of mayo.
steps: Fry the bacon in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 6–8 minutes, turning once, until deeply golden and crisp. Drain on kitchen paper.
Toast the bread until crisp and golden, then spread one side of every slice with the mayonnaise.
Season the tomato slices with the salt and plenty of pepper so they taste of something.
Layer lettuce, tomato, avocado and bacon onto half the bread slices, top with the remaining slices, press down firmly and cut in half on the diagonal.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar wraps with garlic crumbs
recipes.blurb: Seared chicken and crisp lettuce in a creamy parmesan dressing, with garlicky toasted crumbs for crunch.
steps: Heat 5 ml of the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat, add the panko and half the garlic and toast for 2–3 minutes, stirring, until golden. Tip onto a plate.
Season the chicken with the salt and pepper. Add the remaining oil to the pan, turn the heat to medium-high and cook the chicken for 6–7 minutes, turning, until golden and cooked through.
Whisk the mayonnaise, yoghurt, mustard, remaining garlic, parmesan, the zest of the lemon and a good squeeze of its juice into a dressing. Loosen with a splash of water if it is stiff.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 15 seconds each side.
Toss the lettuce with half the dressing, then divide between the wraps with the chicken, a scatter of garlic crumbs and the rest of the dressing. Roll up tightly and halve.

recipes.title: Turkey patty club sandwich with bacon
recipes.blurb: A triple-decker with smoky turkey patties, crisp bacon, avocado and tomato.
steps: Mix the turkey mince with the smoked paprika, salt and pepper. Shape into 2 thin, wide patties about the size of a slice of bread.
Fry the bacon in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 6–8 minutes until crisp, then set aside on kitchen paper.
Wipe the pan, add the oil and cook the patties over a medium heat for 4 minutes on each side, until golden and cooked through with no pink inside.
Toast the bread and spread the mayonnaise over one side of each slice.
Build each club with toast, lettuce, a turkey patty, toast, tomato, avocado and bacon, then a final slice. Press down, secure with cocktail sticks if you have them, and cut into quarters.

recipes.title: Tuna melt on English muffins
recipes.blurb: Creamy tuna with gherkin and spring onion under bubbling cheddar on a toasted muffin.
steps: Heat the grill to high. Toast the muffin halves, cut side up, for 2 minutes until just golden.
Mash the tuna with the mayonnaise, spring onions, gherkins and plenty of pepper.
Top each muffin half with a slice of tomato, a generous pile of tuna and a handful of cheddar.
Grill for 3–4 minutes until the cheese is bubbling and flecked with brown. Let them cool for a minute before eating.

recipes.title: Elote-style corn salad with tortilla chips
recipes.blurb: Charred sweetcorn in a creamy, lime-sharp dressing with feta and chilli, scooped up with crunchy tortilla chips.
steps: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a high heat. Add the sweetcorn in an even layer and leave it for 3 minutes without stirring, then stir and cook for another 3–4 minutes until charred in places.
Tip the corn into a bowl and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Stir in the mayonnaise, yoghurt, the zest and juice of the lime, half the smoked paprika, the chilli and spring onions.
Fold through the feta and half the coriander, then taste for lime.
Serve in bowls topped with the remaining coriander and paprika, with the tortilla chips on the side for scooping.

recipes.title: Chicken, pepper and cheddar quesadillas
recipes.blurb: Crisp, cheesy tortillas stuffed with cumin chicken and sweet pepper, served with lime sour cream.
steps: Toss the chicken with the cumin, smoked paprika and half the salt. Heat 10 ml of the oil in a frying pan over a medium-high heat and cook the chicken and red pepper for 7–8 minutes until the chicken is cooked through. Tip into a bowl.
Stir the spring onions and jalapeños through the chicken. Wipe out the pan.
Lay half the tortillas on a board. Scatter half the cheddar over them, spoon on the chicken, add the rest of the cheese and cover with the remaining tortillas.
Heat a little of the remaining oil in the pan over a medium heat and cook each quesadilla for 2–3 minutes a side, pressing down, until crisp and golden with the cheese melted.
Stir the zest of the lime and a squeeze of juice into the sour cream with the remaining salt. Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve with the lime sour cream.

recipes.title: Smoked salmon smørrebrød with dill cream cheese
recipes.blurb: Buttered rye topped with silky smoked salmon, dill cream cheese, cucumber ribbons and capers.
steps: Beat the cream cheese with half the dill, the zest of the lemon, a squeeze of juice and a good grind of pepper.
Spread a thin layer of butter over each slice of rye, then top with the dill cream cheese.
Fold the smoked salmon in loose ribbons over the top of each slice.
Pile on the cucumber ribbons, radish and capers, finish with the remaining dill and a squeeze of lemon, and eat with a knife and fork.

recipes.title: Swedish-style prawn open sandwiches
recipes.blurb: Creamy dill prawns heaped on dark rye with lemon, red onion and crisp lettuce.
steps: Heat the oil in a frying pan over a high heat and cook the prawns for 2–3 minutes until pink and just cooked through (if yours are already cooked, just warm them through). Tip onto a plate and cool for 5 minutes.
Roughly chop the prawns and mix with the crème fraîche, mayonnaise, most of the dill, the red onion, the zest of half the lemon, a squeeze of juice, the salt and pepper.
Lay a lettuce leaf over each slice of rye.
Heap the prawn mixture on top, scatter over the rest of the dill and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Fattoush with crispy spiced chickpeas
recipes.blurb: Crunchy pitta, sumac and a lemony dressing over a chopped salad with crisp, falafel-style chickpeas.

ingredients.name: Chickpeas (400g tin)
ingredients.prep: drained, rinsed and patted very dry

steps: Heat 15 ml of the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Add the chickpeas with the cumin and half the salt and fry for 8–10 minutes, shaking often, until crisp and golden. Tip into a bowl.
Add another 15 ml of the oil to the pan and fry the pitta pieces over a medium heat for 3–4 minutes until crisp and golden, then toss with half the sumac.
Whisk the remaining oil with the juice of the lemons, the rest of the sumac and salt, and the pepper.
Toss the cucumber, tomatoes, lettuce and parsley with the dressing.
Top with the crisp pitta and chickpeas just before serving so they stay crunchy.

recipes.title: Tabbouleh with sumac prawns
recipes.blurb: A parsley-heavy, lemony bulgur salad topped with quick-seared prawns.
steps: Put the bulgur in a bowl with a pinch of the salt, pour over 200 ml of boiling water and cover. Leave for 15 minutes until tender, then fluff with a fork and let it cool.
Toss the prawns with the sumac, allspice, a little of the oil and a pinch of salt.
Heat a frying pan over a high heat and cook the prawns for 2–3 minutes a side until pink and lightly charred.
Mix the parsley, mint, tomatoes and spring onions into the bulgur with the juice of the lemons, the remaining oil, the rest of the salt and the pepper.
Divide the tabbouleh between plates and top with the warm prawns.

recipes.title: Halloumi and za'atar flatbreads
recipes.blurb: Golden halloumi on za'atar-oiled flatbread with tomato, cucumber and a garlicky yoghurt.
steps: Stir the yoghurt with the zest of half the lemon, a squeeze of juice, the salt and pepper.
Mix 15 ml of the oil with the za'atar and brush it over the naan.
Fry the halloumi in a dry non-stick pan over a medium-high heat for 2 minutes a side until deeply golden. Remove and wipe out the pan.
Warm the naan, oiled side down, in the pan for 1–2 minutes until it starts to crisp.
Toss the tomatoes, cucumber and rocket with the remaining oil and a squeeze of lemon, then pile onto the flatbreads with the halloumi and spoon over the yoghurt.

recipes.title: Bánh mì-style pork meatball baguettes
recipes.blurb: Soy-glazed pork meatballs in a crisp baguette with quick-pickled carrot, cucumber and fresh chilli.
steps: Stir the vinegar and sugar together until the sugar dissolves, add the carrot and leave to pickle for 15 minutes.
Mix the pork mince, garlic and half the soy sauce, then roll into 10 small meatballs.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat and cook the meatballs for 8–10 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through. Add the remaining soy and a splash of water and toss to glaze.
Warm the baguettes in a hot oven or dry pan for 2 minutes to crisp the crust, then spread the cut sides with the mayonnaise.
Fill with the meatballs, drained pickled carrot, cucumber, chilli and plenty of coriander.

recipes.title: Cold sesame noodles with cucumber
recipes.blurb: Chewy udon in a nutty, tangy sesame sauce with cool cucumber and a kick of chilli oil.
steps: Cook the noodles in boiling water for 2–3 minutes, or as the packet says, then drain and rinse under cold water until cool. Drain very well.
Whisk the soy sauce, tahini, sesame oil, vinegar, garlic and chilli oil with 30 ml of warm water until smooth and pourable.
Toss the noodles with the sauce until every strand is coated.
Divide between bowls and top with the cucumber, spring onions and sesame seeds. Eat straight away or chill for up to a day.

recipes.title: Onigiri-style tuna mayo rice bowl
recipes.blurb: Seasoned sesame rice topped with soy tuna mayo, cucumber and avocado, like a rice ball in a bowl.
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, then cook in boiling water for 10–12 minutes. Drain and steam dry in the pan for 5 minutes.
Stir the vinegar and half the sesame seeds through the warm rice.
Mash the tuna with the mayonnaise, half the soy sauce and half the spring onions.
Divide the rice between bowls, pressing it down lightly, and top with the tuna mayo, cucumber and avocado.
Drizzle with the remaining soy sauce and finish with the rest of the sesame seeds and spring onions.

recipes.title: Thai-style chicken larb lettuce cups
recipes.blurb: Hot, sour, salty chicken with fresh herbs and crushed peanuts, spooned into crisp lettuce leaves.
steps: Heat the oil in a frying pan over a high heat, add the chicken mince and break it up with a spoon. Cook for 7–8 minutes until cooked through and lightly golden, with no liquid left in the pan.
Take off the heat and stir in the fish sauce, the juice of the limes and most of the chilli.
Fold through the shallots, mint and most of the coriander while the chicken is still warm.
Spoon into the lettuce leaves and finish with the peanuts, remaining chilli and coriander. Eat with your hands.

recipes.title: Chana chaat with tamarind and lime
recipes.blurb: Spiced chickpeas tossed with tomato, onion, green chilli and a sweet-sour tamarind dressing.
steps: Stir the tamarind paste, sugar, cumin and salt with 30 ml of warm water until smooth, then add the juice of the lime.
Toss the chickpeas, red onion, tomatoes, cucumber and green chilli with the dressing.
Fold through most of the coriander and leave to sit for 5 minutes so the flavours mingle.
Spoon into bowls, crush the tortilla chips over the top for crunch and finish with the remaining coriander.

recipes.title: Ploughman's plate with quick-pickled onion
recipes.blurb: Sharp cheddar, crusty bread, boiled eggs and apple with crunchy pickled onion and gherkins.
steps: Mix the red onion with the vinegar and sugar and leave to pickle for at least 10 minutes, squeezing now and then.
Lower the eggs into boiling water and cook for 9 minutes, then cool in cold water, peel and halve.
Arrange the cheddar, bread, eggs, gherkins, apple and salad leaves on a board or plates.
Spoon the pickled onion and the mustard alongside and serve with the butter.

recipes.title: Tomato and basil soup with garlic croutons
recipes.blurb: Silky tomato soup brightened with fresh basil and topped with olive-oil croutons.
steps: Heat half the oil in a saucepan over a medium heat and soften the onion for 6–7 minutes with the salt. Add 1 clove of garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, sugar, crumbled stock cube and 300 ml of water. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 12 minutes.
Meanwhile, toss the bread cubes with the remaining oil, the remaining garlic and a little pepper, and fry in a pan over a medium heat for 4–5 minutes until golden and crisp.
Add most of the basil to the soup and blend until smooth with a stick blender. Season to taste.
Ladle into bowls and top with the croutons and the remaining basil.

recipes.title: Pea, ham and mint soup
recipes.blurb: Sweet green peas and salty ham in a fast, velvety soup with a swirl of crème fraîche.

ingredients.name: White potatoes
ingredients.prep: peeled and cut into small cubes

steps: Melt the butter in a saucepan over a medium heat and soften the onion for 5 minutes with the salt.
Add the potato, crumbled stock cube and 600 ml of water and simmer for 10 minutes until the potato is tender.
Stir in the peas and cook for 3 minutes, then add the mint and blend until smooth with a stick blender. Season with pepper and thin with a splash of hot water if needed.
Crisp the ham in a dry frying pan over a medium-high heat for 2–3 minutes.
Ladle the soup into bowls and top with the crisp ham and a swirl of crème fraîche.

recipes.title: Tuna and white bean salad with lemon
recipes.blurb: Creamy cannellini beans and flaky tuna with red onion, capers and a punchy lemon dressing.
steps: Whisk the oil with the zest of the lemon, 2 tablespoons of its juice, the salt and plenty of pepper.
Toss the red onion in the dressing and leave for 5 minutes to soften.
Add the beans, tomatoes, capers and most of the parsley and fold gently.
Flake in the tuna, stir once, then finish with the remaining parsley.

recipes.title: Harissa roast veg couscous salad
recipes.blurb: Sticky harissa peppers and courgette with chickpeas and lemony couscous. It is even better cold.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the red pepper, courgette and chickpeas on a tray with the harissa, 15 ml of the oil, the salt and the pepper.
Roast for 20 minutes, turning once, until the vegetables are tender and sticky at the edges.
Meanwhile, dissolve the stock cube in 150 ml of boiling water, pour over the couscous in a bowl, cover and leave for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Stir the remaining oil, the zest of the lemon and a good squeeze of its juice through the couscous.
Fold the roast vegetables and chickpeas through the couscous with the parsley. Serve warm or chilled.

recipes.title: Greek orzo salad with feta and olives
recipes.blurb: Tender orzo with tomato, cucumber, olives and feta in an oregano dressing, good warm or cold.
steps: Cook the orzo in boiling salted water for 9–10 minutes until tender. Drain and rinse under cold water, then drain well.
Whisk the oil with the juice of the lemon, the oregano, the salt and the pepper.
Toss the orzo with the dressing, tomatoes, cucumber, red onion and olives.
Fold through the feta and parsley and taste for lemon. Pack up or eat straight away.

recipes.title: Spanish tortilla bocadillo with roasted peppers
recipes.blurb: A thick potato and onion omelette tucked into a crusty baguette with sweet roasted peppers.
steps: Heat 20 ml of the oil in a small non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Add the potatoes, onion and a pinch of the salt, cover and cook for 12–14 minutes, stirring now and then, until completely soft.
Beat the eggs with the remaining salt and the pepper, then stir in the warm potato and onion.
Wipe the pan, add the remaining oil and pour in the mixture. Cook over a medium-low heat for 6–7 minutes until set underneath.
Slide the tortilla onto a plate, flip it back into the pan and cook for 3 minutes more until golden on both sides.
Fill the baguette with slices of warm tortilla and the roasted peppers, sprinkle with the smoked paprika and cut in half.

recipes.title: Mushroom Reuben-style sandwich on rye
recipes.blurb: Crisp rye with garlicky mushrooms, tangy sauerkraut, melted gruyère and pink pickle dressing.
steps: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a high heat and fry the mushrooms for 6–7 minutes until deep golden. Season with the smoked paprika, salt and pepper and tip into a bowl.
Mix the mayonnaise, ketchup and gherkins into a pink dressing and spread on the inside of each slice of rye.
Fill each sandwich with a layer of mushrooms, sauerkraut and gruyère, then close up and butter the outsides.
Fry the sandwiches in the wiped pan over a medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes a side, pressing down, until crisp and the cheese has melted. Cut in half and serve.

recipes.title: Maple bacon and apple grilled cheese
recipes.blurb: Crisp, buttery bread around sharp cheddar, maple-glazed bacon and thin slices of tart apple.
steps: Fry the bacon in a frying pan over a medium heat for 5–6 minutes until almost crisp, pour in the maple syrup and turn for 1 minute until sticky. Move to a plate.
Spread the mustard on half the bread slices and butter the outside of every slice.
Build each sandwich with half the cheddar, the bacon, the apple slices, a grind of pepper and a second layer of cheese, then top with the other slice.
Cook in a clean pan over a medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes a side, pressing down, until deep golden and the cheese has melted. Rest for a minute and cut in half.

recipes.title: Leek and potato soup with chives
recipes.blurb: A velvety, mellow leek and potato soup finished with chives and plenty of black pepper.
steps: Melt the butter in a saucepan over a medium-low heat, add the leeks, onion and salt and cook gently for 8–10 minutes, stirring, until soft but not coloured.
Add the potato, crumbled stock cube and 500 ml of water, bring to the boil and simmer for 12–15 minutes until the potato is very tender.
Blend with a stick blender until smooth, then stir in the milk and warm through over a low heat. Season with pepper and more salt if needed.
Ladle into bowls and scatter over the chives.

recipes.title: Smoky baked beans on toast with cheddar
recipes.blurb: Baked beans simmered with smoked paprika and garlic, spooned over buttery toast with melted cheddar.
steps: Melt half the butter in a small saucepan over a medium heat and cook the garlic and smoked paprika for 30 seconds.
Add the tomato puree, baked beans and a splash of water, then simmer for 6–8 minutes until thick and glossy. Season with pepper.
Toast the bread and spread with the remaining butter.
Spoon the beans over the toast, top with the cheddar and grill for 1–2 minutes until the cheese melts, then scatter over the spring onions.

recipes.title: Paneer tikka wraps with cool yoghurt
recipes.blurb: Charred tikka paneer, peppers and red onion rolled up warm with lime yoghurt and coriander.
steps: Mix the tikka paste with half the yoghurt and toss through the paneer. Leave for 5 minutes if you have time.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a high heat and cook the red pepper and red onion for 4–5 minutes until charred at the edges. Push to the side.
Add the paneer and cook for 4–5 minutes, turning, until golden and sticky.
Stir the zest of the lime, a squeeze of juice and the salt into the remaining yoghurt.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 15 seconds each side, then fill with the paneer and veg, spoon over the lime yoghurt and scatter over the coriander.

recipes.title: Jerk-style chicken and pineapple rice bowl
recipes.blurb: Allspice-and-thyme chicken with caramelised pineapple on fluffy rice, finished with lime and spring onions.
steps: Mix the chicken with the allspice, thyme, chilli, garlic, soy sauce and half the oil. Leave for 10 minutes.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 10–12 minutes, then drain and keep covered.
Heat the remaining oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 8–10 minutes, turning, until dark, charred at the edges and cooked through. Move to a plate.
Add the pineapple to the pan for 2–3 minutes until caramelised.
Divide the rice between bowls and top with the chicken and pineapple, then finish with the juice of the lime and the spring onions.

recipes.title: Chicken and avocado wraps with lime yoghurt
recipes.blurb: Seared chicken, creamy avocado and crunchy little gem rolled up with a zesty lime yoghurt.
steps: Toss the chicken strips with the cumin, a tablespoon of the oil and a good pinch of salt and pepper.
Heat a frying pan over a medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6-7 minutes, turning, until golden and cooked through. Rest for 2 minutes.
Stir the finely grated zest of the lime and a squeeze of juice into the yoghurt, add the spring onions and season.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 15 seconds each side.
Spread each wrap with lime yoghurt, top with lettuce, avocado and chicken, then roll up tightly and halve to serve.

recipes.title: Tuna, sweetcorn and cheddar toastie
recipes.blurb: A golden, gooey toastie packed with spring onion tuna mayo and a handful of sweetcorn.
steps: Mash the tuna with the mayonnaise, spring onions, half the sweetcorn and plenty of black pepper.
Butter one side of each slice of bread. Turn half the slices butter-side down and spread with the tuna mixture.
Scatter over the remaining sweetcorn and the cheddar, then top with the other slices, butter-side up.
Cook in a medium frying pan for 3-4 minutes per side, pressing down gently, until deep golden and the cheese has melted.
Rest for a minute, then cut in half and serve.

recipes.title: Smoked salmon and cucumber rice bowl
recipes.blurb: Warm jasmine rice with silky smoked salmon, avocado and a sharp soy and rice vinegar dressing.
steps: Rinse the rice, then simmer in plenty of water for 11-12 minutes until tender. Drain well and leave to steam dry for 2 minutes.
Whisk the soy sauce, rice vinegar and sesame oil in a small bowl.
Toss the cucumber with a spoonful of the dressing and let it sit for 5 minutes to soften slightly.
Divide the rice between bowls and top with the cucumber, avocado and torn smoked salmon.
Drizzle over the remaining dressing and finish with spring onion and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Ham, cheddar and apple sourdough toastie
recipes.blurb: Salty ham, sharp cheddar and crisp apple with a dab of mustard between golden sourdough.
steps: Spread the mustard over half the sourdough slices and butter the outside of all the slices.
Layer the ham, apple slices and cheddar on the mustard slices and season with black pepper.
Close with the remaining bread, butter-side out.
Cook in a frying pan over a medium heat for 3-4 minutes each side, pressing down, until the bread is crisp and the cheese has melted.
Slice diagonally and eat while hot.

recipes.title: Halloumi couscous bowl with mint and lemon
recipes.blurb: Golden halloumi over lemony couscous with cherry tomatoes, cucumber and plenty of mint.
steps: Crumble the stock cube into a bowl, add 180 ml boiling water, then stir in the couscous. Cover and leave for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Dress the couscous with half the oil, the zest of the lemon and a good squeeze of juice.
Heat a non-stick frying pan over a medium-high heat and fry the halloumi for 2 minutes each side until deeply golden.
Fold the tomatoes, cucumber and most of the mint through the couscous.
Pile into bowls, top with the halloumi and finish with the remaining mint and black pepper.

recipes.title: Spinach, feta and pepper frittata slices
recipes.blurb: A thick baked-then-grilled frittata that slices cleanly and keeps well for lunchboxes.
steps: Heat the grill to high. Heat the oil in a small ovenproof frying pan and soften the pepper and spring onions for 4 minutes.
Add the spinach and stir until just wilted, about 1 minute.
Beat the eggs with the salt and pepper, then pour into the pan. Scatter over the feta.
Cook on a medium-low heat for 5 minutes until the edges are set but the top is still slightly wet.
Grill for 3-4 minutes until puffed and golden. Cool for 5 minutes, then cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Peanut tofu and rice noodle salad
recipes.blurb: Crispy tofu, crunchy veg and slippery noodles tossed in a lime and peanut dressing.
steps: Soak the noodles in just-boiled water for 6-8 minutes until soft, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the tofu for 8-10 minutes, turning, until crisp on most sides.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, sweet chilli, the juice of the lime and 2 tablespoons of warm water until smooth.
Toss the noodles, cucumber, carrot and coriander with the dressing.
Divide between bowls, top with the tofu and scatter over the peanuts.

recipes.title: Miso tofu udon soup with pak choi
recipes.blurb: A quick, gently savoury broth with chewy udon, soft tofu and fresh ginger.
steps: Bring 700 ml water to a simmer with the ginger. Add the pak choi and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the udon and cook for 2-3 minutes, separating the strands with a fork, until hot through.
Turn the heat down low. Whisk the miso with a ladle of the hot broth until smooth, then stir it back into the pan along with the soy sauce.
Slide in the tofu and warm for 1 minute without boiling.
Ladle into bowls and finish with the spring onions and a few drops of sesame oil.

recipes.title: Black bean and sweetcorn rice bowl with avocado
recipes.blurb: Cumin-spiced beans and corn over fluffy rice with cool avocado, lime and coriander.
steps: Rinse the rice and cook in boiling salted water for 10-12 minutes until tender. Drain and keep covered.
Warm the oil in a pan and add the cumin and chilli flakes for 20 seconds.
Tip in the beans and sweetcorn with a splash of water and cook for 5 minutes, mashing a few beans, until hot and glossy.
Toss the tomatoes and coriander with the juice of half the lime and a pinch of salt.
Spoon the rice into bowls, top with the beans, tomato salsa and avocado, and serve with the remaining lime cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Smoky red lentil and tomato soup
recipes.blurb: A thick, warming soup of red lentils, carrot and tomato with cumin and smoked paprika.
steps: Heat the oil in a saucepan and soften the onion and carrot over a medium heat for 6 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, cumin and smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, chopped tomatoes, the stock cube and 500 ml water. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 18-20 minutes until the lentils collapse.
Blitz with a stick blender until mostly smooth, loosening with water if needed.
Season with salt, pepper and a squeeze of lemon juice before serving.

recipes.title: Curried chicken and raisin pittas
recipes.blurb: Mild curry-spiced chicken in cool yoghurt with sweet raisins, stuffed into warm pitta.
steps: Toss the chicken with half the curry powder and the oil. Fry in a hot pan for 7-8 minutes until golden and cooked through, then cool for 5 minutes.
Stir the remaining curry powder, the raisins, mint and a squeeze of lemon into the yoghurt.
Fold the chicken through the yoghurt dressing and season with salt.
Warm the pittas under the grill for 1 minute and split them open.
Fill with lettuce and the curried chicken.

recipes.title: Greek salad feta pitta pockets
recipes.blurb: Crunchy cucumber, tomato and olives with feta, stuffed into warm pitta with oregano.
steps: Whisk the oil, vinegar, oregano and black pepper in a bowl.
Add the cucumber, tomato, onion and olives and toss to coat.
Fold through the feta gently so it stays in chunks.
Warm the pittas for 30 seconds in a toaster or dry pan, then split along one edge.
Stuff each pocket with the salad and spoon over any dressing left in the bowl.

recipes.title: Caprese ciabattas with pesto and rocket
recipes.blurb: Fresh mozzarella, ripe tomato and peppery rocket piled into soft ciabatta with green pesto.
steps: Split the ciabatta rolls and toast the cut sides for 1-2 minutes if you like them crisp.
Spread the pesto over both halves of each roll.
Layer the tomato and mozzarella on the bases and season well with salt and pepper.
Toss the rocket with the oil and balsamic vinegar and pile on top.
Press the lids on and cut in half to serve.

recipes.title: Quinoa, beetroot and goats' cheese bowl
recipes.blurb: Earthy beetroot and nutty quinoa with creamy goats' cheese, walnuts and a balsamic dressing.
steps: Rinse the quinoa and simmer in 300 ml salted water for 12-15 minutes until the water is absorbed. Fluff and leave to cool slightly.
Whisk the oil, balsamic, mustard, salt and pepper into a dressing.
Toast the walnuts in a dry pan for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Toss the quinoa with half the dressing, the beetroot and the rocket.
Divide between bowls and top with the goats' cheese, walnuts and the remaining dressing.

recipes.title: Black bean and cheddar pepper quesadillas
recipes.blurb: Crisp, cheesy wraps filled with mashed black beans, sweet pepper and spring onion.
steps: Roughly mash the beans with the smoked paprika, leaving some texture.
Mix in the pepper and spring onions.
Spread the bean mixture over half the tortillas, scatter over the cheddar and top with the other tortillas.
Brush a frying pan with a little oil and cook each quesadilla for 3 minutes per side over a medium heat until crisp and the cheese oozes.
Stir a squeeze of lime into the yoghurt, cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve with the dip.

recipes.title: Prawn and lime rice noodle salad
recipes.blurb: Zingy noodle salad with juicy prawns, crunchy veg, mint and a fish sauce and lime dressing.
steps: Soak the noodles in just-boiled water for 6-8 minutes until tender, then drain and rinse in cold water.
Whisk the lime juice, fish sauce and sweet chilli sauce with a tablespoon of water.
Heat the oil in a frying pan and cook the prawns for 3-4 minutes, turning, until pink and curled. Cool for 3 minutes.
Toss the noodles with the cucumber, carrot, herbs and dressing.
Top with the prawns and scatter over the peanuts.

recipes.title: Egg mayo and chive sandwiches with rocket
recipes.blurb: Soft-boiled-then-hard egg mayo with chives and mustard, piled high with peppery rocket.
steps: Lower the eggs into boiling water and cook for 9 minutes, then cool in cold water for 3 minutes and peel.
Mash the eggs with the mayonnaise, mustard, chives, salt and plenty of black pepper.
Toast the bread if you like it crisp.
Spread the egg mayo over half the bread slices, top with the rocket and close with the remaining slices.
Cut in half and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken and parmesan Caesar-style wraps
recipes.blurb: Lemony chicken, crisp little gem and shaved parmesan in a garlicky Caesar-style dressing.
steps: Season the chicken with black pepper and fry in the oil over a medium-high heat for 6-7 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Mix the mayonnaise, mustard, garlic, half the parmesan, the zest of the lemon and a squeeze of juice into a dressing.
Toss the chicken with half the dressing.
Warm the tortillas briefly in a dry pan.
Fill with lettuce and chicken, drizzle over the remaining dressing, sprinkle with parmesan and roll up.

recipes.title: Puy lentil, roasted pepper and spinach salad
recipes.blurb: A no-cook lunchbox salad of earthy lentils, sweet jarred peppers and baby spinach.
steps: Whisk the oil, vinegar, smoked paprika, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Add the red onion and leave for 3 minutes to mellow.
Tip in the lentils and roasted peppers and toss well.
Fold through the spinach and parsley just before serving so the leaves stay fresh.
Spoon into bowls or lunchboxes.

recipes.title: Kimchi egg fried rice
recipes.blurb: Tangy, punchy kimchi fried rice topped with a crispy-edged fried egg and spring onion.
steps: Cook the rice in boiling water for 11-12 minutes, drain and spread on a plate to cool for 5 minutes.
Heat half the vegetable oil in a wok over a high heat and stir-fry the kimchi and white spring onion for 2 minutes.
Add the rice, gochujang and soy sauce and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until hot and lightly crisp.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil in a separate pan until the whites are crisp at the edges.
Divide the rice between bowls, top with the eggs, drizzle with sesame oil and finish with sesame seeds and green spring onion.

recipes.title: Feta shakshuka skillet
recipes.blurb: Eggs baked in a smoky pepper and tomato sauce with crumbled feta and fresh coriander.
steps: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan and cook the onion and pepper over a medium heat for 8 minutes until soft.
Stir in the garlic, paprika and cumin for 1 minute, then add the tomatoes and salt.
Simmer for 8 minutes until thick and jammy.
Make a well in the sauce for each egg and crack them in. Cover and cook gently for 4-5 minutes until the whites are set.
Scatter over the feta and coriander and serve straight from the pan.

recipes.title: Smoked salmon bagels with chive cream cheese
recipes.blurb: Toasted bagels with lemony chive soft cheese, ribboned smoked salmon and cucumber.
steps: Split and toast the bagels until golden.
Beat the soft cheese with the chives, a squeeze of lemon and black pepper.
Spread the cheese generously over all the bagel halves.
Top with cucumber and folds of smoked salmon.
Add a final squeeze of lemon and close up or eat open.

recipes.title: Chorizo, egg and cheddar breakfast burritos
recipes.blurb: Soft scrambled eggs, crisp chorizo and melted cheddar rolled into warm tortillas.
steps: Fry the chorizo in a dry non-stick pan over a medium heat for 4 minutes until it releases its oil and crisps.
Add the pepper and spring onions and cook for 2 minutes.
Beat the eggs with black pepper, add the butter to the pan and pour in the eggs. Stir gently for 2 minutes until softly scrambled.
Warm the tortillas, scatter with cheddar and spoon over the eggs.
Add the coriander, fold in the sides and roll up tightly.

recipes.title: Blueberry yoghurt pancakes
recipes.blurb: Fluffy, tangy pancakes dotted with blueberries and served with yoghurt and maple syrup.
steps: Whisk the flour, sugar, milk and egg yolks into a smooth batter, then stir in half the yoghurt.
Whisk the egg whites to soft peaks and fold gently into the batter for extra lift.
Melt a little butter in a large non-stick pan over a medium heat and spoon in small rounds of batter.
Scatter a few blueberries onto each and cook for 2 minutes until bubbles appear. Flip and cook for 1-2 minutes more.
Stack the pancakes and top with the remaining yoghurt, blueberries and a drizzle of maple syrup.

recipes.title: Berry granola yoghurt pots
recipes.blurb: Layers of thick yoghurt, crunchy granola and fresh berries with a drizzle of honey.
steps: Spoon a layer of yoghurt into the base of jars or glasses.
Add a layer of granola, then half the berries.
Repeat the layers with the remaining yoghurt, granola and berries.
Drizzle over the honey.
Eat straight away for crunch, or chill for up to a day for a softer pot.

recipes.title: Mango berry banana smoothie bowl
recipes.blurb: A thick, icy oat milk smoothie bowl with mango and berries, topped with granola and seeds.
steps: Blend the banana, most of the mango, the frozen berries and the oat drink until thick and smooth, scraping down the sides.
Add a splash more oat drink only if it will not blend.
Spoon into bowls.
Top with granola, pumpkin seeds, blueberries and the remaining mango.
Eat immediately.

recipes.title: Apple cinnamon bircher with walnuts
recipes.blurb: Overnight oats soaked in milk and yoghurt with grated apple, cinnamon, raisins and walnuts.
steps: Stir the oats, grated apple, yoghurt, milk, cinnamon and raisins together in a bowl.
Cover and chill overnight, or for at least 4 hours; the whole step takes about 10 minutes of hands-on time.
Loosen with a splash of milk if the oats have thickened too much.
Spoon into bowls.
Top with the walnuts and a pinch more cinnamon.

recipes.title: Smashed avocado, feta and egg sourdough
recipes.blurb: Chilli-flecked smashed avocado and feta on crisp sourdough, topped with a soft egg.
steps: Toast the sourdough until crisp and golden.
Mash the avocado with the juice of the lemon half, the oil, half the feta and black pepper, keeping it chunky.
Bring a pan of water to a gentle simmer and poach the eggs for 3 minutes for a runny yolk.
Spread the avocado over the toast.
Top each slice with an egg, the remaining feta and a pinch of chilli flakes.

recipes.title: Garlic mushroom and spinach sourdough toast
recipes.blurb: Golden garlicky mushrooms and wilted spinach on thick crisp sourdough with lemon and parsley.
steps: Heat half the oil in a wide pan over a high heat and fry the mushrooms for 6-7 minutes until deeply browned, without moving them too much.
Add the remaining oil and the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the spinach until just wilted, then season with salt, pepper and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Toast the sourdough until crisp.
Pile the mushrooms onto the toast and scatter with parsley.

recipes.title: Spinach, mushroom and cheddar omelette
recipes.blurb: A soft, fluffy omelette folded around buttery mushrooms, wilted spinach and melting cheddar.
steps: Melt half the butter in a non-stick pan and fry the mushrooms for 5 minutes until golden. Add the spinach until wilted, then tip out and keep warm.
Beat the eggs with the salt and pepper.
Wipe the pan, melt a quarter of the remaining butter and pour in half the eggs, stirring gently, then leave for 1 minute until almost set.
Add half the filling and cheddar to one side, fold over the other side and slide onto a plate.
Repeat for the second omelette and finish both with chives.

recipes.title: Lardon and fried egg muffin melts
recipes.blurb: Toasted English muffins with crisp smoked lardons, a fried egg and melted cheddar.
steps: Fry the lardons in a dry pan over a medium heat for 5-6 minutes until crisp, then lift out onto kitchen paper.
Split and toast the muffins.
Add the butter to the pan and fry the eggs for 2-3 minutes until the whites are set.
Spread ketchup on the muffin bases, scatter with lardons and cheddar, then top with the eggs and black pepper.
Grill for 1 minute until the cheese melts, then close with the muffin tops.

recipes.title: Sweet potato and black bean breakfast hash
recipes.blurb: Crisp smoky sweet potato with black beans and peppers, topped with avocado and lime.
steps: Heat the oil in a large frying pan and cook the sweet potato over a medium heat for 12 minutes, turning occasionally, until tender and crisp at the edges.
Add the onion, pepper and smoked paprika and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the black beans and salt and cook for 3 minutes until hot.
Squeeze over half the lime and stir through half the coriander.
Spoon into bowls and top with avocado, the remaining coriander and wedges of lime.

recipes.title: Peanut butter banana and seed toast
recipes.blurb: Thick toast spread with peanut butter and topped with banana, pumpkin seeds, cinnamon and maple.
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Spread each slice generously with peanut butter while still warm.
Arrange the banana slices over the top.
Scatter over the pumpkin seeds and dust with cinnamon.
Finish with a thin drizzle of maple syrup.

recipes.title: Smoky baked bean and egg skillet
recipes.blurb: Baked beans simmered with smoked paprika and baked-in eggs, served with buttered toast.
steps: Warm the oil in a small frying pan and cook the spring onions for 1 minute.
Add the smoked paprika and chilli flakes, then tip in the baked beans and simmer for 3 minutes.
Make a well in the beans for each egg and crack them in.
Cover and cook gently for 4-5 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks still soft.
Toast and butter the bread and serve alongside with black pepper over the top.

recipes.title: Pasta e ceci with rosemary and chilli
recipes.blurb: A thick, creamy Roman chickpea and pasta pot, perfumed with rosemary and finished with a glug of good oil.
steps: Warm 20 ml of the oil in a large pan over a medium heat. Add the onion, carrot and celery with a pinch of salt and cook for 8 minutes, stirring, until soft and sweet.
Stir in the garlic, rosemary, chilli flakes and tomato puree and cook for 1 minute until the puree darkens slightly.

Tip in the chickpeas, crumble in the stock cube and pour over 700 ml of boiling water. Simmer for 10 minutes, then mash about a third of the chickpeas against the side of the pan to thicken the broth.
Add the pasta and simmer for 10-12 minutes, stirring often, until it is just tender and the broth has turned thick and glossy. Loosen with a splash of hot water if it gets too stodgy.
Season with salt and plenty of pepper. Ladle into bowls and finish with the parsley and the remaining oil.

recipes.title: Chicken cacciatore with olives and penne
recipes.blurb: Hunter-style chicken braised with peppers, mushrooms and olives until the tomato sauce clings to every piece.
steps: Season the chicken with salt and pepper. Heat half the oil in a wide, deep pan over a medium-high heat and brown the chicken for 3-4 minutes a side. Lift out onto a plate.
Add the remaining oil with the onion, red pepper and mushrooms and fry for 6 minutes until the mushrooms have lost their water and everything is golden at the edges.
Stir in the garlic and rosemary for 30 seconds, then pour in the red wine and let it bubble for 2–3 minutes until reduced by half. Add the chopped tomatoes and olives with half a tomato tin of water.
Return the chicken and any juices to the pan, cover and simmer gently for 20-25 minutes, turning once, until the chicken is tender and the sauce is thick.
