For the dip, mix the juice of 1 lime with 1 g of the salt and the remaining black pepper in a small bowl, stirring until the salt dissolves.

Heat half the oil in a large frying pan or wok over the highest heat you have. Sear the beef in 2 batches for 2 minutes each, shaking the pan and turning the cubes, until browned outside and pink within. Tip onto a plate.
Add the remaining oil, the onion wedges and the rest of the garlic and sugar and stir-fry for 2 minutes until the onion has charred edges. Return the beef and toss for 30 seconds.
Toss the rocket and tomatoes with a squeeze of the remaining lime. Serve the beef over the leaves with the rice, the lime dip for dunking and the lime wedges.

recipes.title: Vietnamese caramel pork with eggs and pak choi
recipes.blurb: Pork braised in a dark, glossy caramel of fish sauce and pepper, with soft eggs and rice.
steps: Lower the eggs into a pan of boiling water and cook for 7 minutes, then cool under cold running water and peel.
Put the sugar and 30 ml of water in a heavy pan over a medium heat without stirring. Cook for 5–6 minutes until it turns a deep amber, swirling the pan, then take it off the heat.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the pork for 5 minutes until browned, then add the shallots, garlic and ginger for 1 minute.

Add the caramel, the fish sauce, black pepper and 250 ml of water. Bring to a simmer, add the peeled eggs and simmer, partly covered, for 25 minutes, turning the pork and eggs now and then, until the pork is tender and the sauce is thick and sticky.
Meanwhile, rinse the rice and simmer it covered in 300 ml of water with the salt for 12 minutes. Steam the pak choi in a covered pan with a splash of water for 3 minutes until just tender.
Halve the eggs and serve the pork and sauce with the rice and pak choi, topped with the chilli and spring onions.

recipes.title: Chicken phở-style noodle soup
recipes.blurb: A clear, star anise and ginger broth with poached chicken, rice noodles, bean sprouts and plenty of herbs.
steps: Put the onion halves cut-side down and the ginger in a dry saucepan over a high heat. Char for 4–5 minutes until blackened in places, then add the star anise and cinnamon and toast for 30 seconds.
Pour in 1000 ml of water, crumble in the stock cubes and add the fish sauce, sugar and black pepper. Bring to the boil, then lower to a gentle simmer.
Slide in the chicken breasts and poach for 14–16 minutes until cooked through with no pink in the middle. Lift out onto a board and rest for 5 minutes, then shred or slice.
Simmer the broth for another 5 minutes, then strain it through a sieve back into the pan, discarding the aromatics, and keep it hot.
Soak the noodles in just-boiled water for 4–5 minutes, or as the packet says, then drain and divide between deep bowls.
Top the noodles with the chicken and ladle over the boiling-hot broth. Serve with the bean sprouts, spring onions, coriander, basil, chilli and lime wedges for everyone to add at the table.

recipes.title: Beef rendang-style coconut curry
recipes.blurb: Beef simmered until tender in a dry, sticky, deeply spiced coconut and lemongrass sauce.
steps: Blitz the shallots, garlic, ginger and chilli with the ground coriander, cumin, turmeric and cinnamon and 30 ml of water in a small blender or processor to a rough paste.
Heat the oil in a wide, heavy pan over a medium heat. Fry the paste for 5 minutes, stirring, until it darkens and the raw smell goes.
Add the beef and turn it in the paste for 3 minutes. Pour in the coconut milk and 100 ml of water, then add the lemongrass, lime leaves, tamarind, sugar, soy sauce and 1 g of the salt.
Bring to a simmer and cook gently, uncovered, for 40–45 minutes, stirring every 5–10 minutes, until the beef is tender.
Meanwhile, rinse the rice and simmer it covered in 300 ml of water with the remaining salt for 12 minutes. Turn off the heat and leave it covered.
For the last 10 minutes, raise the heat slightly and stir often as the sauce reduces to a thick, dark coating that clings to the beef. Remove the lemongrass and lime leaves and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Tomato & garlic spaghetti
recipes.blurb: Spaghetti in a slow-simmered tomato sauce with plenty of garlic and black pepper.
steps: Bring a large pan of well-salted water to the boil for the spaghetti.
Warm the olive oil in a saucepan over a low heat. Add the garlic and stir for about a minute, without letting it colour.
Stir in the tomato puree, then the chopped tomatoes, sugar and black pepper. Simmer gently for 12 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick and glossy.
Cook the spaghetti for the time on the packet, then drain, keeping a mugful of the water.
Toss the spaghetti through the sauce, loosening with a splash of pasta water if needed. Taste, adjust the salt and serve straight away.

recipes.title: Lentil & tomato stew
recipes.blurb: A thick, cumin-warmed stew of red lentils, carrot and tomatoes that needs very little attention.
steps: Warm the oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Cook the onion and carrot for 8 minutes, stirring, until the onion is soft.
Add the garlic and cumin and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.

Rinse the lentils and add them with the tomatoes, the stock cube crumbled in and 450 ml of water. Bring to the boil, then simmer gently for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are tender and the stew is thick.
Add a splash more water if it catches or gets too thick. Season with salt and pepper and serve in bowls.

recipes.title: Chickpea & spinach curry
recipes.blurb: A quick, mild curry of chickpeas in a turmeric and cumin tomato sauce, finished with wilted spinach.
steps: Put the rice on to cook following the packet, with a good pinch of salt in the water.
Warm the oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Cook the onion for 7 minutes, stirring, until soft, then add the garlic, cumin and turmeric and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and 100 ml of water and simmer gently for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the chickpeas and simmer for 5 minutes until hot through. Add the spinach a handful at a time, stirring until wilted.
Season to taste and serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Pepper & bean rice
recipes.blurb: Red pepper and kidney beans simmered in tomato and stirred through fluffy rice.
steps: Put the rice in a saucepan with 300 ml of water and a pinch of salt. Bring to the boil, cover, reduce to a low simmer and cook for 12 minutes until the water is absorbed. Take off the heat and keep covered.
Meanwhile, warm the oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Cook the onion and pepper for 8 minutes, stirring, until soft.
Add the tomatoes and kidney beans, season, and simmer for 8 minutes until thick and hot through.
Fluff the rice with a fork, stir it through the beans and vegetables, and serve.

recipes.title: Mushroom & pea couscous
recipes.blurb: Golden mushrooms, sweet peas and soft onion tossed through fluffy couscous.
steps: Crumble the stock cube into a heatproof bowl, add the couscous and pour over 200 ml of boiling water. Cover and leave for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Warm the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Cook the onion for 4 minutes, then add the mushrooms and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring, until golden and the liquid has evaporated.
Add the peas and cook for 3 minutes until hot through.
Stir in the couscous, a squeeze of lemon juice, the parsley and plenty of seasoning, and serve.

recipes.title: Roast vegetables & chickpeas
recipes.blurb: A single-tray supper of cumin-roasted carrot, courgette, pepper and crisp chickpeas.

ingredients.name: Red pepper
ingredients.prep: deseeded and cut into 2 cm pieces

steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Put the carrot on a large tray first, as it takes longest.

Roast the carrot for 10 minutes, then add the courgette, pepper, onion and chickpeas to the tray. Toss with the oil, cumin, salt and pepper, spreading everything out in one layer (use two trays if crowded).
Roast for 25 minutes more, turning once halfway, until the vegetables are tender and the chickpeas are crisp at the edges.
Squeeze over the lemon juice and serve straight from the tray.

recipes.title: Potato & vegetable frittata
recipes.blurb: A thick, set omelette of soft potato, red pepper and onion, cooked gently in one pan.

ingredients.name: White potatoes
ingredients.prep: peeled and cut into 1 cm pieces

steps: Put the potato in a small pan of salted water, bring to a simmer and cook for 8 to 10 minutes until just tender. Drain well.
Warm the oil in a 24 cm non-stick frying pan with a lid over a medium heat. Cook the onion and pepper for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the potato to the pan. Beat the eggs with salt and pepper and pour them evenly over the vegetables.
Reduce to a gentle heat, cover and cook for 8 to 12 minutes until the egg is set all the way through, with no runny egg in the middle.
Slide the frittata onto a board, cut into wedges and serve warm.

recipes.title: Warm apple oats
recipes.blurb: Creamy stovetop porridge with soft diced apple and a little cinnamon.
steps: Put the oats, milk, diced apple and cinnamon into a saucepan.
Heat gently, stirring, until it reaches a simmer. Cook over a low heat for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring often so it does not catch, until the oats and apple are soft.
Spoon into bowls and let cool for a minute before eating.

recipes.title: Yoghurt, banana & oats
recipes.blurb: A no-cook bowl of thick yoghurt, rolled oats and sliced banana.
steps: Divide the yoghurt between bowls.
Stir the oats into the yoghurt and leave for 2 minutes to soften slightly.
Fold the sliced banana through, drizzle with the honey, dust with cinnamon and eat straight away.

recipes.title: Tomato & egg toast
recipes.blurb: Soft scrambled eggs cooked with softened fresh tomato, piled onto toast.
steps: Beat the eggs in a bowl with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Warm the oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Add the tomatoes and cook for 4 minutes until softened.
Reduce the heat, pour in the eggs and stir gently with a spatula until set but still soft and creamy.
Toast the bread while the eggs cook, then top with the tomato and egg.

recipes.title: Chickpea & cucumber salad
recipes.blurb: A fresh, no-cook salad of chickpeas, cucumber and tomato dressed with lemon and olive oil.
steps: Put the chickpeas, cucumber and tomatoes in a bowl.
Squeeze in the juice of the lemon, add the olive oil, salt and pepper, and toss well.
Leave for 5 minutes so the flavours mingle, then serve.

recipes.title: White bean & tomato toast
recipes.blurb: Cannellini beans in a simple tomato sauce, spooned over crisp toast.
steps: Put the oil, tomatoes and pepper in a saucepan and simmer gently for 8 minutes, stirring, until slightly thickened.
Add the beans and heat for 4 to 5 minutes until hot through. Season with salt.
Toast the bread, spoon over the beans and tomato, and serve.

recipes.title: Hummus & carrot pitta
recipes.blurb: Homemade lemony hummus stuffed into warm pitta with grated carrot and cucumber.
steps: Blitz the chickpeas, tahini, juice of the lemon, garlic, olive oil, salt and 3–4 tablespoons of cold water in a food processor until smooth, adding more water if too thick.
Warm the pittas briefly in a toaster or dry pan, then split each to make a pocket.
Spread the hummus inside, then fill with grated carrot and cucumber and serve.

recipes.title: Bean & corn chilli
recipes.blurb: A smoky, medium-spicy veg chilli of kidney and black beans with sweetcorn, served over rice.
steps: Warm the oil in a large pan over a medium heat. Cook the onion and pepper for 8 minutes until soft, then add the garlic, paprika, cumin, chilli powder and tomato puree and stir for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and 150 ml of water, then the kidney beans, black beans and half the sweetcorn. Bring to a simmer and cook gently for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick.
Meanwhile, cook the rice following the packet instructions.
Stir in the remaining sweetcorn, season, and heat for 2 minutes. Serve over the rice with the coriander scattered on top.

recipes.title: Chilli jacket potatoes
recipes.blurb: Crisp-skinned baked potatoes piled with smoky bean chilli and melting cheddar.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Prick the potatoes, rub with 10 ml of the oil and a pinch of salt, and bake directly on the shelf for 55 to 60 minutes until the skins are crisp and the middles soft.
About 25 minutes before the end, warm the remaining oil in a saucepan and cook the onion for 7 minutes. Add the garlic and spices and stir for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and beans with 100 ml of water, season, and simmer for 15 minutes until thick.
Split the potatoes, spoon in the chilli, top with the cheddar and spring onions, and serve.

recipes.title: Chilli bean wraps
recipes.blurb: Warm tortillas filled with a quick smoky kidney bean and sweetcorn chilli.
steps: Warm the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft.
Stir in the paprika, cumin and chilli powder for 30 seconds, then add the passata, beans and sweetcorn. Simmer for 8 minutes, mashing a few beans against the pan to thicken, and season.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or microwave for 20 to 30 seconds.
Spoon the chilli down the middle of each tortilla, fold in the sides and serve.

recipes.title: Garlic & chilli spaghetti
recipes.blurb: Aglio e olio style: spaghetti in garlicky chilli oil with parsley and lemon, ready in 20 minutes.
steps: Cook the spaghetti in a large pan of well-salted boiling water for the time on the packet. Before draining, scoop out a mugful of the cooking water.

While the pasta cooks, warm the olive oil in a large frying pan over a low heat. Add the garlic, fresh chilli and chilli flakes and cook gently for 2 to 3 minutes, until the garlic is pale gold. Do not let it brown.
Add the drained spaghetti to the pan with a generous splash of the pasta water and toss over the heat for 1 minute until glossy.
Take off the heat, add the parsley, a squeeze of lemon, salt and pepper, and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Mango overnight oats
recipes.blurb: Creamy overnight oats made with yoghurt and soft golden mango chunks.
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yoghurt and honey together in a bowl or jars.
Fold in two-thirds of the mango, cover and chill overnight, or for at least 4 hours.
In the morning, loosen with a splash of milk if thick, top with the remaining mango and eat cold.

recipes.title: Creamy oat porridge
recipes.blurb: Slow-stirred porridge made with milk until thick, soft and creamy.
steps: Put the oats, milk and a tiny pinch of salt in a saucepan over a medium heat.
Bring to a gentle simmer, then turn the heat low and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring constantly, until thick and creamy.
Stir in the butter, let it stand for a minute, loosen with a splash of milk if needed, then serve hot with the honey drizzled over.

recipes.title: Three bean salad
recipes.blurb: Kidney beans, black beans and chickpeas tossed with crunchy pepper, carrot and red onion in a sharp dressing.
steps: Whisk the vinegar, olive oil, sugar, salt and pepper together in a large bowl.
Add all three beans, the peppers, carrot and red onion and toss until coated.
Stir in the parsley, then leave for 10 minutes (or chill for up to 2 days) so the beans soak up the dressing, and serve.
